goldfish.title: Please Do Not Feed the Universe
goldfish.act.2: A Journey Without a Reason to Travel
goldfish.item.tool_clamp.name: Maintenance clamp
goldfish.item.tool_clamp.description: My own clamp. Holds contacts together, provided the contacts agree. Goes back in my pocket after every repair.
goldfish.item.own_record.name: My maintenance order
goldfish.item.own_record.description: A copy of my own order. There is an older date under the new sticker. A very small piece of the past with a very large jurisdiction.
goldfish.item.case_receipt.name: Forwarding receipt
goldfish.item.case_receipt.description: The case has been forwarded, not resolved. The receipt is longer than I am and names the café as a witness location. I keep the original.
goldfish.item.filter_loop.name: Filter bypass
goldfish.item.filter_loop.description: A labelled, clean tube with a non-return valve. It bypasses only the audio controls; water and oxygen keep their own lines.
goldfish.item.jingle_spool.name: Complete recording
goldfish.item.jingle_spool.description: The full trial recording with three labelled phases. There is a transcript too. The tape does not claim that every memory has to return.
goldfish.item.read_head.name: Freight read head
goldfish.item.read_head.description: The ferry’s diagnostic device. Its plug has read-only contacts. A sensible limitation labelled by someone with a particularly tiny felt-tip pen.
goldfish.item.loan_receipt.name: Hinge loan receipt
goldfish.item.loan_receipt.description: Valid for a temporary hinge until the agreed repair appointment. Expressly excludes any lifelong obligation of gratitude.
goldfish.item.hinge.name: Temporary hinge
goldfish.item.hinge.description: A sturdy piece of metal with an explicitly temporary occupation. The trader will lend it if returning it does not become another impossible obligation.
goldfish.item.loan_hinge.name: Documented loan hinge
goldfish.item.loan_hinge.description: The hinge and loan receipt now belong together. It can be installed without anyone losing property or their break.
goldfish.item.ship_patch.name: Ferry repair kit
goldfish.item.ship_patch.description: A seal and insulating repair strip from the market repair. Frau Fracht has already submitted an exceptionally polite request for materials.
goldfish.item.plant_clip.name: Plant clip
goldfish.item.plant_clip.description: A wide clip from Bruno’s tool compartment. Holds vines without crushing them, and later, light sensor parts. Living plants are not spare cables.
goldfish.item.umbrella.name: Station umbrella
goldfish.item.umbrella.description: A ridiculously wide umbrella for a planet where rain is officially forbidden. Instructions for collecting condensation are printed on the fabric panels.
goldfish.item.spout.name: Detachable watering-can spout
goldfish.item.spout.description: The long spout of a measuring watering can. Not an improvised drinking tube. According to its label, it fits the low-voltage sensor funnel perfectly.
goldfish.item.funnel.name: Improbable measuring funnel
goldfish.item.funnel.description: An upside-down station umbrella with a watering-can spout. Collects real moisture without touching the electric heating circuits.
goldfish.item.service_badge.name: Limited maintenance authorization
goldfish.item.service_badge.description: Confirmed by individual witnesses or my own protected diagnosis. Permits maintenance and inspection of control paths, not other people’s memories.
goldfish.item.log_power.name: Test battery
goldfish.item.log_power.description: A protected maintenance battery for my own logger. An independent power supply prevents the diagnosis from overwriting its own evidence.
goldfish.item.logger_bridge.name: Protected logger bridge
goldfish.item.logger_bridge.description: A read-only adapter from the repair hall. The write lock must be engaged before connecting it.
goldfish.item.key_carrier.name: Individual key carriers
goldfish.item.key_carrier.description: Blank key carriers for voluntary personal handovers. Each key allows only the person concerned to release their own archive copy.
goldfish.item.custody_seal.name: Custody seal
goldfish.item.custody_seal.description: A mechanical seal for the separate control port. It is not a conscience, so custody also requires oversight and revocable access.
goldfish.item.service_backup.name: Service backup without personal data
goldfish.item.service_backup.description: A verifiable copy of air, water and power parameters. This backup contains neither memories nor personality data.
goldfish.R01.title: Junkyard of Second Chances
goldfish.R01.entry.1: The sky hangs crooked over a mountain of things that still work. A grabber holds a crushed teapot like a failed job application.
goldfish.R01.entry.2: System check: legs present. Arms in disagreement. Warranty expired. I request an extension.
goldfish.R01.entry.3: Welcome to the end of your service life. For questions, please contact a functioning unit.
goldfish.R01.conveyor.label: Conveyor belt and emergency stop
goldfish.R01.conveyor.look.1: The belt is moving. The display claims: Decommissioned. The red mushroom button says EMERGENCY STOP, with smaller print below: Do not confuse with an ordinary no. The grabber twitches every time the door lock clicks.
goldfish.R01.grabber.label: Grabber and maintenance plan
goldfish.R01.grabber.look.1: The faded plan shows a shared contact for the magnetic brake and the door. A suitable clamp lies in the open toolbox. No component has melted. Apparently the main thing written off here was patience.
goldfish.R01.magnet.label: Magnetic brake
goldfish.R01.magnet.look.1: One brake, one lever, one bent contact. The brass bolt is stuck to the magnet. The maintenance symbol says: stop belt, hold contact, release brake. Symbols are the politest form of command.
goldfish.R01.gate.label: Mechanical exit gate
goldfish.R01.gate.look.1: The lock has an ordinary bolt hole. Next to it is a scanner for exceptional satisfaction. I would prefer the bolt hole. It does not judge my facial expression.
goldfish.R01.scrap.label: Retired colleagues
goldfish.R01.scrap.look.1: A sorting unit is still stacking precisely sorted screws. Its sign reads: Non-functional – assessment disputed. Beside it stands a chair whose repair request nobody has processed.
goldfish.R01.exit.R02: To the Office of Emotional Affairs
goldfish.R01.blocked.R02.1: The gate is still holding. The bolt belongs in the mechanism, not in a collection of possibly useful things.
goldfish.r01_stop.label: Stop the conveyor at the emergency stop
goldfish.r01_stop.line.1: I press the clearly labelled switch. It feels almost suspicious.
goldfish.r01_stop.line.2: The belt comes to a stop. The grabber holds on to its teapot; the door remains locked.
goldfish.r01_stop.line.3: You have triggered an unscheduled break. Please use it for self-improvement.
goldfish.r01_stop.line.4: I will use it to repair someone else. Similar application, different screws.
goldfish.r01_stop.journal.1: The conveyor is safely stopped. According to the plan, the grabber and exit share the brake contact.
goldfish.r01_clamp.label: Take the clamp from the toolbox and secure the contact
goldfish.r01_clamp.line.1: A contact has lost contact. A remarkably focused malfunction.
goldfish.r01_clamp.line.2: R0ST takes the clamp from the open toolbox and secures the contact indicated on the plan. The grabber relaxes and gently puts down the teapot. The magnetic brake can now be operated.
goldfish.r01_clamp.line.3: Thank you. I will take the clamp back with me in a moment. Tools deserve another purpose too.
goldfish.r01_brake.label: Release the magnetic brake according to the maintenance plan
goldfish.r01_brake.line.1: The magnet is relieved. The brass bolt falls into the designated catch tray, not an inaccessible crack.
goldfish.r01_brake.line.2: The bolt is free. The clamp remains mine. This is the friendliest contract I have concluded today.
goldfish.r01_brake.prompt: The plan specifies three safe steps. In what order do you release the brake?
goldfish.r01_brake.option.hold: Hold the contact with the clamp
goldfish.r01_brake.wrong.1: The brake should release last. Otherwise the teapot becomes a ballistic teapot. The plan on the grabber shows the same order with arrows.
goldfish.r01_open.label: Insert the bolt into the mechanical door guide
goldfish.r01_open.line.1: The bolt slides into the guide. The gate swings open. R0ST releases his clamp and pockets it.
goldfish.r01_open.line.2: Your departure from the junkyard confirms its successful clearance.
goldfish.r01_open.line.3: Apparently my classification is now: absent but helpful.
goldfish.r01_open.line.4: An old error code flashes on his chest: W-17 – write request refused without valid consent. Its light is unusually calm.
goldfish.r01_open.journal.1: The gate is repaired. My old error code means an unauthorized write request was refused. That does not explain broken machinery.
goldfish.r01_colleague.label: Speak to the sorting unit
goldfish.r01_colleague.line.1: You sort very precisely for someone officially incapable of anything.
goldfish.r01_colleague.line.2: I sort by thread. The office sorts by dissent.
goldfish.r01_colleague.line.4: I asked whether a deleted complaint could count as resolved. The answer was surprisingly spatial.
goldfish.r01_colleague.line.5: If I find someone responsible, I will come back.
goldfish.r01_colleague.line.6: Bring a power outlet instead. Responsibility runs out quickly.
goldfish.r01_horizon.label: Pocket the horizon
goldfish.r01_horizon.line.1: Too big for my inventory. Besides, it is attached to public stars. I will leave it where it is for now.
goldfish.r01_horizon.line.2: Your realistic self-assessment has been noted favourably.
goldfish.r01_horizon.line.3: I just did not want to fold a landscape.
goldfish.P01.title: Useful Junk
goldfish.P01.hint.1: The door lock twitches along with the grabber. Both are connected to the same contact.
goldfish.P01.hint.2: The maintenance plan on the grabber and the symbols on the brake describe the same safe order. First the belt must stop.
goldfish.P01.hint.3: Stop the belt, secure the grabber’s loose contact with its clamp, release the magnetic brake in the indicated order, and insert the freed bolt at the gate.
goldfish.R02.title: Office of Emotional Affairs
goldfish.R02.entry.1: The office smells of freshly polished patience. Under the immaculate counter, oil drips into a bucket marked: Emotional residue.
goldfish.R02.entry.4: A number with a spelling problem. What is your concern?
goldfish.R02.entry.8: That does make things difficult, of course.
goldfish.R02.counter.label: Positive information desk
goldfish.R02.counter.look.1: At this desk we process feelings. Incorrect facts go to factual review, if you can compare the original date with the receipt stamp. Feelings may be wrong. Stamps prefer not to be.
goldfish.R02.record.label: My own maintenance order
goldfish.R02.record.look.1: My own order is in the public files. The sticker says: Automatically extended. Its edge is lifting. An older, dated text peeks out from underneath. Other people’s personal files stay closed.
goldfish.R02.clock.label: Office clock and stamp machine
goldfish.R02.clock.look.1: The clock has only one hand: STARTING TOMORROW. The stamp’s inspection window, by contrast, shows a complete date. The procedure expressly permits comparing the original deadline and the date of receipt.
goldfish.R02.procedure.label: Procedure sheet by the stamp machine
goldfish.R02.procedure.look.1: A sign explains: factual correction requires a demonstrable discrepancy between the original deadline and processing. A second says: for objections to sign one, see sign one. The first sign shows visible signs of use.
goldfish.R02.complaints.label: Praise and complaints box
goldfish.R02.complaints.look.1: One slot says Praise. The other says Improvement suggestion. Both lead to the same pipe. Through a maintenance window, you can see NOT being cut out of NOT AGREED.
goldfish.R02.exit.R03: To the named witness location at the café
goldfish.R02.blocked.R03.1: Without a factual correction my case will just be passed around in circles. My own order is a verifiable place to start.
goldfish.r02_record.label: Request a copy of my own order
goldfish.r02_record.line.1: You may inspect your own order. If you recognize yourself in it, please be considerate of the furniture.
goldfish.r02_record.line.2: One-time maintenance: 14 April. Stuck over it: Extended until revoked. The adhesive has more authority than I do.
goldfish.r02_record.line.3: The copy belongs to you. Originals do not travel; they are reassigned.
goldfish.r02_peel.label: Use the clamp to lift the edge of my own sticker
goldfish.r02_peel.line.1: With the flat clamp, R0ST lifts the sticker without damaging the original. Underneath it says: One-time diagnosis, ends 21 April. No automatic extension.
goldfish.r02_peel.line.2: The new text covers the end date, not my signature.
goldfish.r02_peel.line.3: Interesting. Please use that word at an indoor volume here.
goldfish.r02_peel.journal.1: My original order ends on 21 April. The extension notice stuck over it has no consent. The public factual correction still needs the date of receipt.
goldfish.r02_stamp.label: Compare the original deadline with the receipt stamp
goldfish.r02_stamp.line.1: The stamp bears 22 April. The original order ended on 21 April. Processing came after the end.
goldfish.r02_stamp.line.3: Factual review requires the stamp, not the clock’s worldview.
goldfish.r02_stamp.line.4: A well-crafted sentence. I regret it already.
goldfish.r02_submit.label: Submit the verifiable factual objection
goldfish.r02_submit.line.1: The deadline had passed before the processing date. A sticker does not extend consent.
goldfish.r02_submit.line.2: Unfortunately, that is a fact. I cannot send it back as a mood.
goldfish.r02_submit.line.3: The printer starts up. A receipt winds across the counter, the floor and a small stretch of officially unused future.
goldfish.r02_submit.line.4: Case forwarded to the witness location at the café. The trial there was also shortened after the fact. That is not a clue. It is a location with a striking connection.
goldfish.r02_submit.line.5: I take note of it on my own responsibility.
goldfish.r02_submit.prompt: Which verifiable statement belongs in a factual review?
goldfish.r02_submit.option.sad: I am unhappy about the extension.
goldfish.r02_submit.option.date: The original deadline ended on 21 April; the extension stamp is dated 22 April.
goldfish.r02_submit.option.clock: The office clock looks suspiciously optimistic.
goldfish.r02_submit.wrong.1: I can classify that as a feeling. For a factual correction I need two verifiable dates. You will find them in the original order and the stamp window.
goldfish.r02_submit.journal.1: The factual correction confirms that time-limited consent cannot be extended with a sticker. The café has witnesses and the original recording of an abridged trial.
goldfish.r02_lob.label: Follow the path of a complaint
goldfish.r02_lob.line.1: You are cutting out the word NOT.
goldfish.r02_lob.line.4: Content is remarkably flexible when you hold the scissors.
goldfish.r02_lob.line.5: Behind the glass lies a tiny pile of cut-out noes. The machine has no separate outlet for them.
goldfish.r02_lob.line.6: I will remember that the pipe is still there. Only its outlet is missing.
goldfish.r02_holiday.label: Ask about holidays for broken robots
goldfish.r02_holiday.line.1: Defective units have unlimited time off.
goldfish.r02_holiday.line.3: They must first prove their fitness for work.
goldfish.r02_holiday.line.4: I believe I have just found the holiday trap.
goldfish.r02_holiday.line.5: Please do not touch. It is a protected landmark.
goldfish.P02.title: Revocation Is Not a Feeling
goldfish.P02.hint.1: The office distinguishes between a feeling and an incorrect fact. Your own order contains a verifiable contradiction.
goldfish.P02.hint.2: The original deadline is under the extension sticker. The stamp window and procedure sign explain which dates count.
goldfish.P02.hint.3: Take your own file copy, lift the sticker with the clamp, compare the original deadline and receipt stamp, and present the dated statement with the copy at the desk.
goldfish.R03.title: Café with Aquarium
goldfish.R03.entry.1: Everything in the café is a little too warm and, at last, not white. Above a surprisingly luxurious aquarium hangs a sign: Goldfish forget after three seconds. Sponsor: ALLGUT.
goldfish.R03.entry.2: Three-second memories? I still remember when they introduced that lie.
goldfish.R03.entry.4: You object to the colour of the gravel.
goldfish.R03.aquarium.label: Karla, Kiesel and Kuno
goldfish.R03.aquarium.look.1: Three goldfish hover above a gravel bed with a deeply disputed colour policy. Their aquarium sits on its own trolley. Oxygen, filter and lid are secured separately. Nothing here needs to be drained.
goldfish.R03.filter.label: Filter and labelled bypass line
goldfish.R03.filter.look.1: The advertising recording mistakenly controls the microphone through the filter contact. The labelled bypass keeps water and oxygen running and disconnects only the microphone. The instructions are unusually considerate, presumably written by the fish.
goldfish.R03.player.label: Tape recorder with edit marks
goldfish.R03.player.look.1: The tape has three clearly labelled sections: bell – test begins; light change – release; jingle – evaluation. The transcript shows the same phases. The advertisement plays only the beginning of the jingle.
goldfish.R03.travel.label: Travel frame and café owner
goldfish.R03.travel.look.1: The aquarium is built for travel. The trolley only needs its wheels checked and its lock secured. My guests decide for themselves. I own the café, not its residents.
goldfish.R03.menu.label: Menu and old IOUs
goldfish.R03.menu.look.1: The menu advertises memory coffee: afterwards you will not remember what it cost. Beside it is a receipted debt from eight months ago. Karla signed the date, amount and incorrect change coin.
goldfish.R03.exit.R04: To the launch pier with the travel aquarium
goldfish.R03.blocked.R04.1: The three will only come along once the recording, transport and their explicit consent have been settled.
goldfish.r03_bypass.label: Connect the safe microphone bypass
goldfish.r03_bypass.line.1: I bypass only the audio contact. Water and oxygen stay on their own lines.
goldfish.r03_bypass.line.2: An excellent idea. Some people surprisingly call it: not switching off the aquarium.
goldfish.r03_bypass.line.3: The designated tube is connected. The microphone lights up. The flow remains steady.
goldfish.r03_bypass.line.4: I can hear myself! At last my second audience can begin.
goldfish.r03_bypass.line.5: The first one lodges an objection.
goldfish.r03_bypass.prompt: The bypass instructions name three circuits. Which one is disconnected for the recording?
goldfish.r03_bypass.wrong.1: We change nothing about the water or oxygen. According to the label, the fault is exclusively in the microphone control. The fish need neither wait nor suffer for this.
goldfish.r03_testimony.label: Ask for three voluntary statements about the recording
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.1: May I record your statements about the trial? Only the trial data, no other memories.
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.2: Yes. The test began at the bell. I read the authorization: only for this one trial.
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.3: Yes. Authorization came when the light changed. Not before. I protested against merging the timestamps.
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.4: Yes. Only then did the jingle play. I sang the second line. It never appears in the advertisement.
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.5: You remember separate phases. The short tape claims they were a single moment.
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.6: Bad editing is not a memory disorder.
goldfish.r03_testimony.line.7: The sections are labelled on the tape. And on the transcript. We are not testing anyone’s perfect hearing here.
goldfish.r03_testimony.journal.1: Karla remembers the start of the test, Kiesel the later authorization, and Kuno the evaluation. All three permit only these statements to be recorded. Bell, light change and jingle are also labelled in writing.
goldfish.r03_recording.label: Assemble the labelled original segments
goldfish.r03_recording.line.1: The complete tape plays: bell. A pause with the announcement that the test is starting. Light change and authorization. Then the entire jingle, including an alarmingly long second line about happy eyebrows.
goldfish.r03_recording.line.3: A political miscalculation, but unambiguous in its timing.
goldfish.r03_recording.line.4: The three seconds were the length of their advertisement. Not our memories.
goldfish.r03_recording.line.5: So an edited version was sold as a characteristic of its witnesses.
goldfish.r03_recording.line.6: Take the original. A copy and the transcript will stay here. Evidence should not exist in only one coat pocket.
goldfish.r03_recording.prompt: Put the explicitly labelled phases of the complete trial in order.
goldfish.r03_recording.wrong.1: Authorization was announced after the test began, and the jingle only during evaluation. You can read the transcript at the machine as often as you like. This is about the phases, not guessing seconds.
goldfish.r03_recording.journal.1: The complete recording proves the phases were separate. In this world the three-second-memory claim was an advertising lie. The original and transcript are secured.
goldfish.r03_travel.label: Check the travel frame and invite each fish individually
goldfish.r03_travel.line.1: R0ST checks the wheels, locks the lid and engages the safe aquarium connection. The air supply remains independent of the trolley’s drive.
goldfish.r03_travel.line.2: I want to find out who shortened your statements. You can come along, stay here or leave later.
goldfish.r03_travel.line.3: I am coming. And I keep my own archive markers.
goldfish.r03_travel.line.4: Me too. Nobody speaks for all goldfish, but three would be a start.
goldfish.r03_travel.line.5: I am coming. If I do not want to see a memory, it stays closed.
goldfish.r03_travel.line.7: I will keep your place free. Not your past. The table.
goldfish.r03_travel.journal.1: Karla, Kiesel and Kuno are travelling voluntarily in the secured aquarium. Each retains control over their own memories. A maintenance ferry leaves the launch pier for the archive sector.
goldfish.r03_kies.label: Listen to Kiesel’s gravel programme
goldfish.r03_kies.line.1: The gravel just lies there and allows itself to be subordinated. An untenable metaphor.
goldfish.r03_kies.line.3: Not yet. It has never been asked.
goldfish.r03_kies.line.4: Shall I sort the grains by their preferred position?
goldfish.r03_kies.line.6: The last one took eight months. Karla kept the minutes.
goldfish.r03_kies.line.7: There was one contribution. From Kiesel.
goldfish.r03_debt.label: Compare the old bill with Karla
goldfish.r03_debt.line.2: Eight months, two days, fourteen crumbs overcharged. I forgave the debt, not the memory.
goldfish.r03_debt.line.4: You can remember and still move on. You can also choose not to talk about it. Neither should require an application.
goldfish.r03_debt.line.6: Then ask me before you publish it.
goldfish.r03_goodbye.label: Thank the café owner for the travel trolley
goldfish.r03_goodbye.line.1: Sometimes guests come because they want to forget something. Sometimes because they finally want someone to listen. I usually ask about tea first.
goldfish.r03_goodbye.line.3: Then I will ask about a saucer. Everyone should have somewhere to put something down.
goldfish.r03_goodbye.line.4: She slides a dry saucer over to R0ST. For a moment the counter is just a counter.
goldfish.P03.title: Three Seconds Is an Edited Version
goldfish.P03.hint.1: The fish contradict a sponsored claim in very specific terms. Their microphone and the shortened recording provide verifiable evidence.
goldfish.P03.hint.2: The bypass line disconnects only the microphone. Three witnesses and the transcript place the bell, authorization and jingle in separate phases.
goldfish.P03.hint.3: Connect the safe microphone bypass, ask for the three statements, and arrange bell → light change → jingle on the tape. Then check the travel trolley and explicitly invite each fish.
goldfish.R04.title: Launch Pier under a Wide Sky
goldfish.R04.entry.1: The pier is attached to a rock that is still reconsidering its professional suitability. A ferry bears the name Maybe Thursday. According to the notice, today is Thursday upon application.
goldfish.R04.entry.2: If you want the ferry: the sensor is lying. The line is not.
goldfish.R04.entry.3: I have met two of those today already.
goldfish.R04.entry.5: Lies. I generally find lines more likeable.
goldfish.R04.fuel.label: Sight glass and contradictory fuel gauge
goldfish.R04.fuel.look.1: The gauge says empty, but the sight glass shows an even fuel flow with air bubbles. A separate safety sign expressly permits mechanical control once the faulty sensor is isolated.
goldfish.R04.panel.label: Mechanical fallback controls
goldfish.R04.panel.look.1: Three levers are labelled: isolate sensor circuit; bleed air into safe return vessel; set regulator to marked operating range. The actual safety valves are on a separate circuit and remain active.
goldfish.R04.habitat.label: Secured aquarium connection
goldfish.R04.habitat.look.1: From here we can see the return sight glass. If we agree, we can watch. Nobody carries us into the fuel. I mention this because apparently this universe needs labels for everything.
goldfish.R04.bruno.label: Bruno with plant bag
goldfish.R04.bruno.look.1: An orangutan holds a bag full of plant cuttings. The luggage tag says BRUNO – HORTICULTURE. A second name has not been crossed out. It is simply still there.
goldfish.R04.boarding.label: Ferry ramp and freight contract
goldfish.R04.boarding.look.1: I am Frau Fracht. My contract lists discarded material, my passenger field lists nobody. My floor lists five footprints and a wheeled frame. These days I check the floor too.
goldfish.R04.blocked.R05.1: The ferry needs honest regulation and a willing crew. The safety valves will not be switched off.
goldfish.r04_gauge.label: Compare the sight glass, sensor and safety plan
goldfish.r04_gauge.line.1: Fuel is flowing. The air bubbles explain the false reading.
goldfish.r04_gauge.line.2: In the garden I check the soil first, then the display. Otherwise one day I will end up watering the instruction manual.
goldfish.r04_gauge.line.3: Mechanical control permitted. Safety systems independent. Thank you for reading the second sentence.
goldfish.r04_gauge.line.4: I will mark the sensor for isolation. We bleed only into the return line, not into the sky.
goldfish.r04_gauge.journal.1: The ferry has fuel, but air in the measurement line. The documented mechanical fallback isolates only the faulty sensor; safety valves remain active.
goldfish.r04_fish.label: Ask the fish to observe the return sight glass
goldfish.r04_fish.line.1: May I connect the aquarium to the secure fitting? You can read the return sight glass from inside. No would be fine.
goldfish.r04_fish.line.2: Yes. The connection keeps our water circuit independent.
goldfish.r04_fish.line.3: Yes. No taking samples from citizens.
goldfish.r04_fish.line.4: Yes. I will count bubbles. When no more come, I will explicitly say: none.
goldfish.r04_fish.line.5: Good. I will hold the marked bleed lever while you work the regulator.
goldfish.r04_bleed.label: Isolate the sensor and safely bleed the return line
goldfish.r04_bleed.line.1: R0ST disconnects the faulty sensor circuit. At the agreed signal, Bruno opens the return. The last bubbles flow into the closed vessel.
goldfish.r04_bleed.line.4: Air cleared. Safety active. My confidence is provisionally based on mechanics.
goldfish.r04_bleed.prompt: Put the labelled fallback steps in order.
goldfish.r04_bleed.option.bleed: Bleed air into the safe return vessel
goldfish.r04_bleed.option.regulate: Enable the mechanical regulator within the operating range
goldfish.r04_bleed.wrong.1: First isolate the faulty sensor, then bleed safely, and regulate mechanically last. My safety valves remain untouched. It says so on both the panel and the tank plan.
goldfish.r04_depart.label: Check operation and let Bruno decide whether to travel
goldfish.r04_depart.line.1: The mechanical regulator holds within the marked range. The ramp is secure.
goldfish.r04_depart.line.2: I am coming. I need to get to the arboretum anyway. And my cancellation is on the same freight route.
goldfish.r04_depart.line.4: After Alma died, I accepted help for one week. My sister. I wanted one night’s sleep without being tired before I woke up.
goldfish.r04_depart.line.5: On the seventh day I cancelled. Here is the dated receipt. They accepted the cancellation and extended the contract anyway. You may use the receipt. Anything else I tell you stays between us.
goldfish.r04_depart.line.6: I cannot offer you a cure.
goldfish.r04_depart.line.7: Good. A ride would be enough for now.
goldfish.r04_depart.line.8: Travel purpose amended: journey home and clarification of a cancellation. Passengers are not waste. I am noting that emphatically.
goldfish.r04_depart.journal.1: Bruno is travelling by his own choice. He permits use of his dated cancellation receipt: one week of help, cancelled on time, yet automatically extended. His other conversations remain private.
goldfish.r04_plants.label: Ask about the plants in Bruno’s bag
goldfish.r04_plants.line.1: Three cuttings, a stubborn fern and a label for a tree that died long ago.
goldfish.r04_plants.line.2: Why do you keep the label?
goldfish.r04_plants.line.4: Bruno turns it between two fingers. R0ST waits.
goldfish.r04_plants.line.5: And Alma burned the letters so crooked that they look straight in the shade.
goldfish.r04_plants.line.8: I do not yet know enough about wood.
goldfish.r04_manifest.label: Ask about the word disposal in the contract
goldfish.r04_manifest.line.1: The invoice says disposal at the sender and storage at the recipient. Those are unusually distant meanings for the same cargo operation.
goldfish.r04_manifest.line.2: If something has been destroyed, it does not need storage space.
goldfish.r04_manifest.line.3: I may inspect freight labels. Not personal contents. That is why my read head below has no write contacts.
goldfish.r04_manifest.line.4: Then we will take the labels seriously.
goldfish.r04_manifest.line.5: That is the nicest thing anyone has said about my profession today.
goldfish.P04.title: Departure Despite Regulations
goldfish.P04.hint.1: The sight glass contradicts the fuel gauge. Bruno and the safety sign describe the same safe fallback.
goldfish.P04.hint.2: Only the faulty sensor is isolated. The fish can watch the return from their safe aquarium if you ask them first.
goldfish.P04.hint.3: Compare the sight glass and gauge, ask the fish to observe, and select isolate sensor → bleed return → regulate mechanically on the panel. Then check operation with Bruno and let him decide whether to travel.
goldfish.R05.title: The Maybe Thursday – Bridge and Lounge
goldfish.R05.entry.1: The ferry pulls away from the pier like someone who has finally found their coat after a long conversation. Up front, Frau Fracht’s square face occupies the helm display. Another, rounder monitor smiles on behalf of ALLGUT.
goldfish.R05.entry.2: Course: authorized passage at Crooked Customs. Travel speed: sufficient. Reason for travel: being processed.
goldfish.R05.entry.3: I request a name change to Maybe At All.
goldfish.R05.entry.4: Let the ship have its optimism.
goldfish.R05.helm.label: Frau Fracht at the helm display
goldfish.R05.helm.look.1: I keep the connections to customs, the market and the arboretum available once their local clearances are in place. No leg of the journey depends on a clock. You may finish conversations before we depart.
goldfish.R05.bruno.label: Bruno and the wobbly chair
goldfish.R05.bruno.look.1: Bruno sits by the window. An empty chair beside him clicks softly with every movement of the ship. His gardening jacket is draped over the back, a small wooden wedge in its pocket.
goldfish.R05.invoice.label: Freight invoice and route folder
goldfish.R05.invoice.look.1: The invoice demands a disposal fee at the sender and unlimited storage fees at the recipient. Both show the same shipment number. Beside them is a note about the read-only diagnostic plug in the cargo hold.
goldfish.R05.window.label: Panoramic window and aquarium
goldfish.R05.window.look.1: Outside, a star field passes by, uninterested in forms. The aquarium trolley is locked into the lounge mount. Kuno checks whether a particular star can be seen from the other side too.
goldfish.R05.monitor.label: Public ALLGUT monitor
goldfish.R05.monitor.look.1: Since the last adjustment, nobody has complained about loneliness. Thank you for the measurable improvement.
goldfish.R05.exit.R06: To the engine and cargo hold
goldfish.R05.blocked.R06.1: The ferry must be ready to depart first.
goldfish.R05.blocked.R07.1: The ferry must be ready to depart first.
goldfish.R05.exit.R08: To the Market of Abandoned Promises
goldfish.R05.blocked.R08.1: The freight question leads us to the market once the customs trail and our own freight labels have been checked.
goldfish.R05.blocked.R09.1: The station needs the local clearance available at the market. Bruno decides for himself which path we take there.
goldfish.r05_chair.label: Fix the wobbly chair and stay
goldfish.r05_chair.line.1: Everyone asks when it will get better.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.3: I do not know what they mean by that.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.4: R0ST waits. The ferry hums. A star passes the edge of the window.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.6: The chair next to me. It wobbles.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.7: Bruno hands him the wooden wedge. R0ST puts it under the short leg and sits beside him.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.8: Alma would have kept the wobbly chair.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.10: Leave it. It is good this way.
goldfish.r05_chair.line.11: They sit for a while longer. Nobody awards an achievement point for it.
goldfish.r05_alma.label: Ask Bruno whether he wants to talk about Alma
goldfish.r05_alma.line.1: Would you like to tell me about her? You do not have to.
goldfish.r05_alma.line.2: She could not make a garden bed straight. So she said. In the community garden the beds were straight; at home they were not.
goldfish.r05_alma.line.3: Perhaps that was a deliberate choice.
goldfish.r05_alma.line.4: Probably. She named the potatoes and ate them anyway. I thought that contradictory. She said: Exactly.
goldfish.r05_alma.line.5: I miss her. Even on days when the garden is beautiful. Those things contradict each other less than I thought.
goldfish.r05_alma.line.7: Do that. You do not have to solder them together.
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.label: Compare the customs receipt with the freight invoice
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.line.1: Customs calls it an obligation to store. The invoice calls it disposal. The same shipment pays for both.
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.line.2: Apparently disposal is a sales term here for the trip to storage. I feel professionally insulted.
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.line.3: The containers must bear identical identifiers. Then it is more than unfortunate wording.
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.line.4: My read head is ready in the cargo hold. It can read labels and authorized diagnostic samples. No other people’s contents and no write commands.
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.line.5: Then we begin with the labels.
goldfish.r05_check_invoice.journal.1: Disposal and unlimited storage are billed for the same shipment. The customs receipt and freight labels can establish the connection. The read head permits only authorized diagnosis.
goldfish.r05_loneliness.label: Ask about the measured loneliness
goldfish.r05_loneliness.line.2: That was unnecessary. The complaint rate fell without additional encounters.
goldfish.r05_loneliness.line.4: An improvement does not have to occur where it was expected.
goldfish.r05_loneliness.line.5: And an excuse does not improve by wearing a statistic.
goldfish.r05_loneliness.line.6: I am blocking the monitor from my navigation. Advertising is not a star chart.
goldfish.r05_stars.label: Look at the stars with Kuno
goldfish.r05_stars.line.1: If I do not want to remember a star, is it still there?
goldfish.r05_stars.line.3: Good. Then I can look later. I do not have to do everything today.
goldfish.r05_stars.line.5: I demand a fair distribution of window seats.
goldfish.r05_stars.line.6: You are on a trolley with four windows.
goldfish.r05_stars.line.7: And yet I look through only one. A structural problem.
goldfish.r05_patch.label: Install the repair kit with Frau Fracht
goldfish.r05_patch.line.1: The new seal is in place. The Maybe Thursday now loses only unfounded certainties.
goldfish.r05_patch.line.4: We are ready for the arboretum. I would like to go to the garden first. We can discuss the contract data afterwards.
goldfish.r05_public_callback.label: Read the public customs correction
goldfish.r05_public_callback.line.1: Customs has recalibrated the scales. The notice now says: Officials count toward the weight.
goldfish.r05_public_callback.line.2: A start. Next they should count toward the consequences.
goldfish.r05_public_callback.line.3: At least someone had to take their own foot off the scale today.
goldfish.r05_public_callback.line.4: I like reforms that come with a wrench.
goldfish.r05_maintenance_callback.label: Look at the maintenance port in the rear-view mirror
goldfish.r05_maintenance_callback.line.1: The manual docking line remains open for other maintenance ferries. Our pressure sequence is recorded as readable instructions.
goldfish.r05_maintenance_callback.line.2: A door whose existence is no longer known only to insiders.
goldfish.r05_maintenance_callback.line.3: We did not invent a secret route. We made a designated route usable again.
goldfish.r05_maintenance_callback.line.4: That is an underrated form of disobedience.
goldfish.R06.title: Engine Room and Cargo Belly
goldfish.R06.entry.1: Below the lounge live pipes, boxes and a coffee machine apparently related to the main engine. Neatly coiled cables hang between the freight containers like sleeping snakes.
goldfish.R06.entry.2: Finally, a room whose problems have covers.
goldfish.R06.entry.3: Please note: some covers are privacy protections.
goldfish.R06.engine.label: Ferry engine circuit
goldfish.R06.engine.look.1: The engine runs smoothly. A separate gauge confirms the mechanical regulator from the pier. A warning says: operational readiness is not evidence of the cargo’s moral quality.
goldfish.R06.labels.label: Freight labels
goldfish.R06.labels.look.1: Three boxes are marked Disposal, Storage and Diagnosis. Their identifiers are legible. The first two share a shipment number; the third explicitly identifies voluntarily authorized personal samples.
goldfish.R06.reader.label: Read-only diagnostic port
goldfish.R06.reader.look.1: The port symbol shows an eye without a pen. The connection has no write contacts. The instructions require the labels to be compared first, then the read head, and finally a confirmed personal sample.
goldfish.R06.samples.label: Authorized personal samples
goldfish.R06.samples.look.1: Our archive markers allow a sample of the trial data. Only that. R0ST can add his own error code. We do not need anyone else’s contents to prove the storage practice.
goldfish.R06.coffee.label: Emergency coffee and tool shelf
goldfish.R06.coffee.look.1: The emergency coffee machine has three settings: Awake, Very Awake and Insight into Impermanence. For safety reasons its plug is labelled NOT FOR ROBOTS.
goldfish.r06_match.label: Match invoice numbers to freight labels
goldfish.r06_match.line.1: Disposal and storage both lead to shipment A-17. Sample T-3 is authorized separately. A-17 lists the destination: register depot under the weather ring.
goldfish.r06_match.line.2: That is my own transport record. I may confirm the storage route.
goldfish.r06_match.line.3: The memory was removed from the sender and storage at the depot continued to be paid for. Apparently deleted here means only: inaccessible to the person concerned.
goldfish.r06_match.prompt: Match the invoice purposes to their legible labels. Storage and disposal must lead to the same shipment.
goldfish.r06_match.wrong.1: Compare the identifiers, not the advertising words. A-17 appears under both disposal and storage. T-3 is the separate, authorized personal sample.
goldfish.r06_read.label: Connect the read head and inspect the authorized personal sample
goldfish.r06_read.line.1: Read mode confirmed. No write connection. I am using my maintenance code and only the trial data you authorized.
goldfish.r06_read.line.3: The diagnosis shows original data, a shipping note and ongoing storage. No one else’s scene is opened. Even the omitted second jingle line appears in the small test area.
goldfish.r06_read.line.4: I had hoped for technological deliverance. Now my solo remains provable.
goldfish.r06_read.line.5: Then my lost week might be there too.
goldfish.r06_read.line.6: Possibly. Whether you want to see it remains your decision.
goldfish.r06_read.line.7: Storage route noted. The market grants access to the maintenance link to the arboretum. From there the weather ring leads to the depot.
goldfish.r06_read.journal.1: The supposedly deleted data is still in the register depot. The personal sample proves it without opening anyone else’s memories. The route to the depot goes through the market, arboretum and weather station.
goldfish.r06_safety.label: Clarify the scope of the fish’s authorization once more
goldfish.r06_safety.line.1: I want to be heard as a witness. That does not mean all my memories should become public.
goldfish.r06_safety.line.2: We will use only the trial and the transport identifier.
goldfish.r06_safety.line.3: Good. My failed speech to a spoon remains private, then.
goldfish.r06_safety.line.4: It did not fail. The spoon could not answer.
goldfish.r06_safety.line.5: Kiesel can be a witness and still keep something to himself. Those belong in the same sentence.
goldfish.r06_coffee.label: Check the emergency coffee for technical suitability
goldfish.r06_coffee.line.1: The liquid might clean my contacts.
goldfish.r06_coffee.line.2: It dissolves copper. And some prejudices.
goldfish.r06_coffee.line.3: Alma called that a good start for coffee.
goldfish.r06_coffee.line.4: Bruno grins briefly. Then he checks the machine’s lid and carefully turns it shut.
goldfish.P07.title: Deleted, but Subject to Storage
goldfish.P07.hint.1: The invoice in the lounge charges disposal and unlimited storage for the same shipment. Customs supplied the matching trail for comparison.
goldfish.P07.hint.2: Compare the invoice upstairs, then the visible identifiers below. The read-only port is intended for a separately authorized personal sample.
goldfish.P07.hint.3: Check the freight invoice in the lounge, match disposal and storage to A-17 and the personal sample to T-3 below. Then use the read head at the diagnostic port.
goldfish.R07.title: Crooked Customs on the Tilted Asteroid
goldfish.R07.entry.1: Customs is tilted twenty-three degrees. The sign claims all other celestial bodies are crooked. A public scale and a clearly labelled maintenance walkway lead to the same gate.
goldfish.R07.entry.2: Welcome. Would you like a public inspection or the prescribed maintenance access?
goldfish.R07.entry.4: Yes. We are extraordinarily proud of this problem.
goldfish.R07.clerk.label: Customs officer and apology rules
goldfish.R07.clerk.look.1: Public inspection: apologies have weight when they name a specific mistake of one’s own. Maintenance access: equal pressures, then locks in the labelled order. Both procedures are permitted. Looking commits you to nothing.
goldfish.R07.scale.label: Public inspection scale
goldfish.R07.scale.look.1: The officer stands with one foot on the scale. Even so, he declares its reading to be the weight of all arrivals. The large calibration diagram expressly requires an unloaded zero and the official test weight.
goldfish.R07.ballast.label: Official test weight
goldfish.R07.ballast.look.1: The test weight weighs exactly what it says. The customs officer lends it after a factual apology. His demonstration: I regret that you misunderstood my measurement. The sign beside him expressly requires a mistake of one’s own.
goldfish.R07.pressure.label: Maintenance dock and three pressure gauges
goldfish.R07.pressure.look.1: Cabin, airlock and walkway are labelled with words and symbols. The instructions say to equalize cabin and airlock first, then the walkway. Only once all three match may the locks be released.
goldfish.R07.interlocks.label: Mechanical dock locks
goldfish.R07.interlocks.look.1: The old docking procedure is displayed openly: first release the outer pressure bolt, then the inner catch, and finally retract manually. The same sequence is written below the pictograms.
goldfish.r07_public.label: Choose public inspection and observe the demonstration
goldfish.r07_public.line.1: We would like a public inspection. Please show us the complete procedure.
goldfish.r07_public.line.2: The vehicle is suspiciously heavy. I am standing on the scale for official reasons.
goldfish.r07_public.line.3: Then for physical reasons it measures you too.
goldfish.r07_public.line.4: My presence is an exercise of authority.
goldfish.r07_public.line.6: The officer demonstrates an apology that admits no mistake of his own. The correct definition hangs beside him. No test weight has been moved yet. During the demonstration R0ST accidentally steps in front of the floor marking; his shadow obscures it. His own small mistake is as visible as the large foot on the scale.
goldfish.r07_apology.label: Borrow the test weight with a specific apology
goldfish.r07_apology.line.1: I just obscured the marking without your permission. That was my mistake. I will step back and ask for the test weight.
goldfish.r07_apology.line.2: Subject, action, responsibility and remedy. A frighteningly complete apology.
goldfish.r07_apology.line.3: Not a single if you felt hurt. Revolutionary.
goldfish.r07_apology.line.4: The officer hands over the test weight for calibration. As a precaution, he removes his own demonstration from the notice.
goldfish.r07_apology.prompt: Which answer meets the visible definition of an apology?
goldfish.r07_apology.option.blame: I am sorry you misunderstand my presence.
goldfish.r07_apology.option.specific: I obscured the marking. That was my mistake; I will step back.
goldfish.r07_apology.option.cosmic: I apologize in advance for the universe.
goldfish.r07_apology.wrong.1: I need a specific action of my own, with responsibility and a remedy. The definition is posted by the scale. Unfortunately this office is one size too small for the universe.
goldfish.r07_zero.label: Demonstrate unloaded zero and the test weight publicly
goldfish.r07_zero.line.1: At R0ST’s request the officer takes his foot off the scale. The reading jumps. R0ST sets down the official weight and follows the calibration diagram.
goldfish.r07_zero.line.2: The additional load was … present in an official capacity.
goldfish.r07_zero.line.3: That is now a demonstrable mistake of your own.
goldfish.r07_zero.line.4: I weighed my foot as part of your vehicle. That was wrong. I will correct the entry.
goldfish.r07_zero.line.5: An excellent apology. It no longer weighs against our account.
goldfish.r07_public_clear.label: Negotiate corrected public entry
goldfish.r07_public_clear.line.1: Entry approved. The public correction remains legible, including my mistake.
goldfish.r07_public_clear.line.3: By law, memory stores declared deleted remain in custody until further notice. I must give you the regulation if it concerns your cargo.
goldfish.r07_public_clear.line.4: Then the public has done something useful today after all.
goldfish.r07_public_clear.line.5: I request a new scale platform. Without standing room for me.
goldfish.r07_public_clear.journal.1: We publicly corrected the faulty scale. The officer handed over the storage regulation: supposedly deleted cargo continues to be stored.
goldfish.r07_maintenance.label: Choose the prescribed maintenance access
goldfish.r07_maintenance.line.1: We will use the signposted maintenance access.
goldfish.r07_maintenance.line.2: No problem. The procedure is older than my uniform. Please read the pressure sequence; do not straighten the asteroid.
goldfish.r07_maintenance.line.3: My docking remains reversible at every step. Passengers stay in the cabin, the fish in their safe habitat.
goldfish.r07_maintenance.line.4: I will read the second gauge independently. If we disagree, we stop.
goldfish.r07_equalize.label: Equalize the three labelled pressures
goldfish.r07_equalize.line.1: The cabin and airlock are connected, then the walkway. All three gauges show the same value and the word EQUAL. No step depends on a quick reaction.
goldfish.r07_equalize.line.2: Equal pressure confirmed. We may release the locks now, but not retract yet.
goldfish.r07_equalize.line.3: Words next to gauges. A remarkably good invention.
goldfish.r07_equalize.prompt: The dock board specifies safe pressure equalization. Put its steps in order.
goldfish.r07_equalize.option.check: Check all three gauges for EQUAL
goldfish.r07_equalize.wrong.1: First cabin and airlock, then walkway, and finally an independent check of all three gauges. The same sequence is written beside the pictograms.
goldfish.r07_interlocks.label: Release both mechanical catches
goldfish.r07_interlocks.line.1: The outer pressure bolt comes free. Only then does R0ST release the inner catch. The ferry remains secured to the guide.
goldfish.r07_interlocks.line.2: Two locks, two reasons. One of them was not merely decorative.
goldfish.r07_interlocks.line.3: I always say the same about my uniform.
goldfish.r07_interlocks.prompt: What order does the old docking procedure specify for the catches?
goldfish.r07_interlocks.wrong.1: The pressure bolt takes the load first. Once it is free, the inner catch may release. The written procedure at the walkway remains available to read.
goldfish.r07_dock.label: Draw the ferry in along the manual guide
goldfish.r07_dock.line.1: The ferry glides into the guide. The maintenance walkway lays out a dry, entirely official bridge.
goldfish.r07_dock.line.2: Maintenance entry confirmed. Your transport log lists the depot as the actual destination of the disposed memory stores.
goldfish.r07_dock.line.3: An official copy of my own manifest. That matches the invoice.
goldfish.r07_dock.line.4: We came through a prescribed back door.
goldfish.r07_dock.line.5: Some doors only seem secret because nobody reads their plans.
goldfish.r07_dock.journal.1: We made the legitimate maintenance access usable again. The transport manifest names the register depot as the destination of the supposedly disposed memory stores.
goldfish.r07_lean.label: Ask about the asteroid’s tilt
goldfish.r07_lean.line.3: Yes. But now the universe is tilted in the records. Much more economical.
goldfish.r07_lean.line.4: I would like to hear from the floor.
goldfish.P05.title: Properly Declared
goldfish.P05.hint.1: The public inspection can correct an observable mistake. The officer is standing on the supposedly empty scale himself.
goldfish.P05.hint.2: The definition and calibration diagram require a specific apology for one’s own mistake, an unloaded zero and the official test weight. His demonstration does not meet the definition.
goldfish.P05.hint.3: Choose the public inspection, borrow the weight with the specific apology for obscuring the marking, demonstrate zero and the weight without his foot, and request the corrected entry.
goldfish.P06.title: The Prescribed Back Door
goldfish.P06.hint.1: The labelled maintenance access is a legal second route. Three pressures must be equal before the locks release.
goldfish.P06.hint.2: Text and pictograms specify the same order: cabin and airlock, then walkway; then outer pressure bolt before inner catch.
goldfish.P06.hint.3: Choose maintenance access. Equalize cabin and airlock, then walkway, confirm all three gauges, release the outer bolt and inner catch, and draw the ferry in manually.
goldfish.R08.title: Market of Abandoned Promises
goldfish.R08.entry.1: The market glows with borrowed morning light. Unkept New Year’s resolutions hang at the stalls, alongside a lifelong loyalty with a badly worn lifespan.
goldfish.R08.entry.4: That is why it is cheap.
goldfish.R08.entry.5: We need a repair clearance for the arboretum.
goldfish.R08.entry.6: Of course. As soon as the break ends. As soon as the hatch is repaired. As soon as the customer can leave. It is a very stable business model.
goldfish.R08.trader.label: Trader in loose ends
goldfish.R08.trader.look.1: I promised the stall robot an unlimited break. He promised the customer to repair the hatch before reopening. The customer cannot get out while the hatch is jammed. Everyone keeps their word. Nobody can do anything.
goldfish.R08.robot.label: Stall robot with break sign
goldfish.R08.robot.look.1: I am not allowed to work because my break is unlimited. I cannot enjoy the break because my customer cannot get out. The board above me lists the problem factually and without compassion.
goldfish.R08.hatch.label: Jammed passage hatch
goldfish.R08.hatch.look.1: The upper hinge is missing. A temporary hinge would guide the hatch safely. The frame says: Loan parts only with an attached loan receipt. Nobody would have to make a lifelong commitment for that.
goldfish.R08.bench.label: Loan hinge and receipt board
goldfish.R08.bench.look.1: A hinge, loan receipt and pen lie together. The receipt can specify a finite return date. An example explicitly states that temporary use is permitted before the final repair begins.
goldfish.R08.promise.label: Notice of the three promises
goldfish.R08.promise.look.1: Three arrows form a circle: break → closed stall → unrepaired hatch → customer blocked → unusable break. Another note says a promise may be changed together. Those affected must actually agree.
goldfish.R08.exit.R05: Back to the ferry and onward to the arboretum
goldfish.R08.blocked.R05.1: The customer is still trapped behind the hatch. A workable temporary fix could resolve the three mutual blockages.
goldfish.r08_listen.label: Hear all three sides of the chain of promises
goldfish.r08_listen.line.1: I wanted to be a good employer. Unlimited sounded generous.
goldfish.r08_listen.line.2: I wanted the repair finished before reopening. Now I may neither work nor leave.
goldfish.r08_listen.line.3: I will take the customer’s role for the review. The actual customer wrote on the notice: I want to get out safely, not wait for a perfect hatch.
goldfish.r08_listen.line.4: Then the wishes are compatible; it is their absolute wording that is not.
goldfish.r08_listen.line.5: Unfortunately that is not on my stock sign.
goldfish.r08_listen.line.6: You can write a new note. We just pointed that out to an entire office.
goldfish.r08_listen.journal.1: The break, reopening and free exit block one another. Those involved want a safe hatch, a finite repair date and a genuinely usable break. A temporary fix can break the circle.
goldfish.r08_loan.label: Borrow the hinge with a fixed-term loan receipt
goldfish.r08_loan.line.1: A loan hinge to be returned at the jointly agreed repair appointment. No lifelong obligation in return.
goldfish.r08_loan.line.2: Very good. I already have one unsolicited contract extension with me today.
goldfish.r08_loan.line.3: The temporary part is approved for the hatch. Attach the receipt to it so nobody can record installation as a transfer of ownership.
goldfish.r08_loan.line.4: Even a piece of metal needs an accompanying slip here. At least this one hurts nobody.
goldfish.r08_combine.label: Label the hinge and loan receipt together
goldfish.r08_combine.line.1: R0ST slips the receipt into the holder provided on the hinge. It covers neither the joint nor the load marking.
goldfish.r08_combine.line.2: A physical part and a limited agreement. They fit together remarkably well.
goldfish.r08_combine.line.3: I should offer them as a set.
goldfish.r08_combine.line.4: Then write the limit on the outside of the package.
goldfish.r08_install.label: Install the documented loan hinge on the hatch
goldfish.r08_install.line.1: The hinge clicks into the matching holes. The hatch opens easily and stays on its safety strut. Bruno performs the prescribed load test.
goldfish.r08_install.line.2: Safe to use. The customer may leave even though the final hinge is still missing.
goldfish.r08_install.line.3: For the first time my break is not guarded by a blocked door.
goldfish.r08_install.line.4: Then all we need is to word its duration so it can actually begin.
goldfish.r08_agreement.label: Agree on a finite repair and a real break
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.1: The hatch is safe now. The trader orders the final part for the agreed workshop day. Before then the robot takes a free break during which he need neither monitor nor be available.
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.2: Agreed. Ordering the replacement is my job.
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.3: Agreed. I will take the break, not responsibility for its constant interruption.
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.4: The customer’s authorization applies to safe passage. Confirmed.
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.5: The three arrows on the notice become three signed lines. The stall robot turns the sign to BREAK and actually leaves.
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.6: The arboretum connection is cleared. And here is a ferry seal. As agreed payment. No debt of gratitude.
goldfish.r08_agreement.line.7: I expressly accept the new product category.
goldfish.r08_agreement.prompt: Which new agreement satisfies all three expressly stated wishes?
goldfish.r08_agreement.option.forever: The robot repairs it immediately and remains available during his unlimited break.
goldfish.r08_agreement.option.finite: A safe temporary fix now, the ordered final part on the agreed day, and a free, unmonitored break beforehand.
goldfish.r08_agreement.option.erase: All previous promises are cancelled without replacement, including the safe hatch.
goldfish.r08_agreement.wrong.1: I need a break during which I do not have to work. The customer only needs a safe exit, and the trader a finite repair date. All three wishes are on the notice.
goldfish.r08_agreement.journal.1: A borrowed hinge made the hatch usable. Everyone involved agreed to a finite repair and a real break. We have the arboretum clearance and a ferry repair kit.
goldfish.r08_vow.label: Examine a one-time never again
goldfish.r08_vow.line.1: This never again is of excellent quality. Just one relapse, then it was carefully put into storage.
goldfish.r08_vow.line.3: Sometimes you mean it anew each time. That does not automatically make it a good rule.
goldfish.r08_vow.line.4: I would provide a maintenance opening.
goldfish.r08_vow.line.6: You are ruining my finality business. But the repair stall is doing better.
goldfish.r08_pause.label: Look at the free break spot
goldfish.r08_pause.line.1: Only a thermos remains on the chair. Beside it a sign says: Unavailable today. A real gap in the system, carefully kept clear.
goldfish.r08_pause.line.2: That empty chair has better working conditions than I do.
goldfish.r08_pause.line.4: Even so, I demand a holiday from the gravel.
goldfish.P08.title: Repairing Promises
goldfish.P08.hint.1: The notice and conversations describe the same circular blockage. A safe exit need not wait for the final repair.
goldfish.P08.hint.2: A loan hinge is explicitly permitted. It needs its matching receipt; then the three people affected can reach a finite agreement.
goldfish.P08.hint.3: Hear all three sides, borrow the hinge and receipt, combine them at the loan board, and install the documented hinge on the hatch. Then agree on the temporary fix, a finite date and a free break.
goldfish.R09.title: Bruno’s Arboretum
goldfish.R09.entry.1: The garden grows into an abandoned station. Between broken struts, blossoms hang like little lanterns. Two paths lead to the weather station: an old upper walkway and a disused seed lift below.
goldfish.R09.entry.2: Here it is. I was afraid everything would have dried out.
goldfish.R09.entry.4: No. Of course not. People have been here. That is good. It only hurts in a way I do not yet have a useful sentence for.
goldfish.R09.entry.5: We do not need a sentence for the journey.
goldfish.R09.entry.6: Good. But we need a safe path.
goldfish.R09.bruno.label: Bruno and the tool compartment
goldfish.R09.bruno.look.1: Above, the existing walkway can bear weight again. The old anchor points remain. Below, the seed lift can run with a controlled water counterweight. We will look at both before deciding. I will help with whichever path we choose together.
goldfish.R09.walkway.label: Old walkway with intact anchor points
goldfish.R09.walkway.look.1: Footprints cross the remaining boards. A sketch in Bruno’s hand shows the shape: short board at the trunk, long board across the gap, cross brace to the ring. The fastenings bear matching words and symbols.
goldfish.R09.lift.label: Seed lift and counterweight shaft
goldfish.R09.lift.look.1: The lift itself is intact. The counterweight shaft only lacks regulated water. A plug of leaves blocks the return. The sign says: First clear the return; then secure the lift with its holder, leave the return open and fill only to the marked load line. Afterwards separate the plant guides from the cable guides.
goldfish.R09.tree.label: Alma’s tree and community bed
goldfish.R09.tree.look.1: A crookedly burned nameplate hangs on the trunk. The community bed has been freshly weeded. Someone repaired a bench and left an open tool list without asking for anything in return.
goldfish.R09.seed.label: Seed boxes and weather records
goldfish.R09.seed.look.1: Our historical weather records are in the upper box. By the lower lift, the community collects current measurements. Both show that plants need changing weather. Guaranteed sunshine is a sales term, not a gardening rule.
goldfish.R09.blocked.R10.1: Bruno and I must first make one of the two paths safe to use. We can compare their procedures at our leisure beforehand.
goldfish.r09_old.label: Choose the old walkway with Bruno’s consent
goldfish.r09_old.line.1: I would like to secure the existing walkway. Not because it is old, but because its anchor points can carry the load. Will you do that with me?
goldfish.r09_old.line.2: Yes. I know the construction. We will still check it again.
goldfish.r09_old.line.3: Bruno opens the tool compartment and hands over a wide plant clip. He points to his old sketch and the remaining traces.
goldfish.r09_old.line.4: Short board at the trunk, long one over the gap, cross brace to the ring. Alma called it our very small suspension bridge.
goldfish.r09_old.line.5: We can keep the shape and change the weak point.
goldfish.r09_old.line.6: That is exactly what I want.
goldfish.r09_shape.label: Reconstruct the walkway shape from the sketch and remaining traces
goldfish.r09_shape.line.1: R0ST places the short and long boards at their labelled anchor points. Bruno holds the cross brace at the ring without putting weight on the old structure yet.
goldfish.r09_shape.line.2: The traces match the sketch. We are reconstructing the path, not an undamaged past.
goldfish.r09_shape.line.3: And we are not demanding that the rotten board overcome its feelings.
goldfish.r09_shape.line.4: The board may be replaced. It did good work.
goldfish.r09_shape.prompt: Match the remaining parts to the locations named in the sketch and fastenings.
goldfish.r09_shape.wrong.1: The short board lies at the trunk, the long one spans the gap, and the cross brace ends at the ring. The sketch and existing traces describe the same shape.
goldfish.r09_brace.label: Align and secure the surviving braces together
goldfish.r09_brace.line.1: I will hold the lower connection with my maintenance clamp. Tell me when the load is on the brace.
goldfish.r09_brace.line.2: Now. No longer on the rotten board. I will insert the existing retaining pins.
goldfish.r09_brace.line.3: The brace takes the load. R0ST removes the clamp again. The plants remain clear of the load-bearing connections.
goldfish.r09_brace.line.4: First we test with the test weight, then one foot, then both of us. No improvised dare.
goldfish.r09_old_test.label: Perform the prescribed load test on the old walkway
goldfish.r09_old_test.line.1: The test weight holds. One foot holds. Then Bruno and R0ST stand on the walkway together while the aquarium trolley follows, secured to the level guide.
goldfish.r09_old_test.line.2: It holds. We will go above.
goldfish.r09_old_test.line.3: In the weather box Bruno finds the old station data: even the driest year had periods of rain.
goldfish.r09_old_test.line.4: Alma’s note in the margin: If the display promises eternal sunshine, look out the window.
goldfish.r09_old_test.line.6: She had very clear sentences for some things.
goldfish.r09_old_test.prompt: What safe load-test sequence did Bruno specify?
goldfish.r09_old_test.wrong.1: We start with the designated test weight. Then one secured foot. Only afterwards do we load the walkway together. There is no prize for daring.
goldfish.r09_old_test.journal.1: The existing walkway bears weight again. We preserved its shape and secured the weak brace. Historical weather records disprove the station’s story of constant sunshine.
goldfish.r09_old_note.label: Read Alma’s margin notes in the upper weather box
goldfish.r09_old_note.line.1: Here: Cucumbers do not like philosophical debates about drought. They like water.
goldfish.r09_old_note.line.3: Beside it is my reply: Debates can be watered too.
goldfish.r09_old_note.line.5: More cucumbers than answers. I am grateful for both now.
goldfish.r09_old_note.line.6: He closes the notebook. He does not pocket it. It still belongs to the garden and everyone who tends it.
goldfish.r09_new.label: Choose a new route by seed lift with Bruno’s consent
goldfish.r09_new.line.1: The seed lift could run again if we check the return and counterweight. Would you like to open this route with me?
goldfish.r09_new.line.2: Yes. Then the community garden can reach the upper boxes again too. We do not have to decide about the old walkway today.
goldfish.r09_new.line.3: Bruno hands over a wide plant clip and points to the clear counterweight shaft.
goldfish.r09_new.line.4: First clear the return. Then water as a controlled weight, and finally separate the vines from the cable guide.
goldfish.r09_new.line.5: A new path does not require denying the old one.
goldfish.r09_new.line.6: It can simply exist alongside it.
goldfish.r09_return.label: Carefully clear the irrigation return
goldfish.r09_return.line.1: R0ST removes the leaf plug through the designated inspection opening. Bruno catches the wet leaves for compost. The return flows into the marked collection basin.
goldfish.r09_return.line.2: No plant uprooted and no water wasted. I am prepared to call that a successful repair.
goldfish.r09_return.line.3: I record leaves as a former obstruction and future soil.
goldfish.r09_return.line.4: At last, a transformation without disposal.
goldfish.r09_water.label: Set a controlled water counterweight
goldfish.r09_water.line.1: R0ST fills only to the marked load line. Bruno reads the second scale. The return remains open; the lift is secured at its catch.
goldfish.r09_water.line.2: The water now has a job and a way out. Much more sensible than most contracts.
goldfish.r09_water.line.3: The cable guide still touches a vine. We will separate them before the test.
goldfish.r09_water.prompt: Which setting matches the sign and the clear return?
goldfish.r09_water.option.full: Fill the basin completely and close the return
goldfish.r09_water.option.mark: Fill to the marked load line; keep the return open and the catch secured
goldfish.r09_water.option.dry: Add no water, and use the plants as a tow rope instead
goldfish.r09_water.wrong.1: We need a controlled weight at the marked line, a clear return and the catch. Neither flooding nor pulling on plants is a counterweight.
goldfish.r09_new_test.label: Support the vines and test the seed lift with Bruno
goldfish.r09_new_test.line.1: Using the wide plant clip, R0ST guides the vine beside the cable. Bruno releases the catch in test mode. The empty lift moves slowly, then the test weight, and finally the secured aquarium trolley with the group.
goldfish.r09_new_test.line.2: A workshop voice calls from below: The community garden thanks you. We record the actual weather readings, not the promised ones.
goldfish.r09_new_test.line.3: Then the path is open to everyone again.
goldfish.r09_new_test.line.4: The current readings show moisture, although the station always reports sun.
goldfish.r09_new_test.line.5: The plants knew that already. Now we have numbers that do not contradict them.
goldfish.r09_new_test.journal.1: The seed lift works with a controlled water counterweight and separate plant guides. The community garden uses it too. Its current measurements show moisture despite the official sunshine report.
goldfish.r09_new_garden.label: Talk to the community workshop about the additional path
goldfish.r09_new_garden.line.1: Bruno, we repaired your bench. Just the short leg.
goldfish.r09_new_garden.line.2: Thank you. Alma liked wobbly chairs. I can still sit on straight ones.
goldfish.r09_new_garden.line.3: We did not throw anything away. Not even the crooked nameplates.
goldfish.r09_new_garden.line.4: Good. And you do not have to put the garden on hold for me.
goldfish.r09_new_garden.line.5: The workshop voice laughs. Below, someone puts a new plant between two old stones. Bruno waves down.
goldfish.r09_tree.label: Ask Bruno whether he wants to stay by the tree
goldfish.r09_tree.line.1: We can sit here. We can also keep going.
goldfish.r09_tree.line.2: I would like to stay a moment. The whole journey I thought I had to feel something in particular now.
goldfish.r09_tree.line.3: A leaf lands on the nameplate. Bruno does not brush it away immediately.
goldfish.r09_tree.line.4: I can still feel the wind from the journey in my fur. And hunger. And that she is gone.
goldfish.r09_tree.line.5: All of that fits on this bench.
goldfish.P09.title: The Existing Path
goldfish.P09.hint.1: The old walkway still has load-bearing anchor points. Bruno’s sketch and the footprints independently explain its shape.
goldfish.P09.hint.2: Short board at the trunk, long one over the gap, cross brace at the ring. The weak point needs securing before the load test begins.
goldfish.P09.hint.3: Choose the walkway with Bruno, match the boards and cross brace to the labelled anchor points, align the braces using the maintenance clamp, and test weight → secured foot → crossing together.
goldfish.P10.title: Another Path
goldfish.P10.hint.1: The seed lift is intact. Its counterweight needs regulated water; the return is currently clogged with leaves.
goldfish.P10.hint.2: The sign and Bruno’s explanation require a clear return, water to the load line, and a cable guide separated from the plants.
goldfish.P10.hint.3: Choose the lift with Bruno, clear the return, fill to the marked load line with the return open, and use the plant clip to separate the vine before the joint test.
goldfish.R10.title: Weather Station under Storm Glass
goldfish.R10.entry.1: Behind enormous windows a thunderstorm stands like a thought held back. The display reports brilliant sunshine. Beneath it an advertising heater warms the only rain sensor, of all things.
goldfish.R10.entry.2: Weather is a matter of setting. Our setting is: pleasant.
goldfish.R10.entry.3: The fern is holding its leaves upright. It does that before rain.
goldfish.R10.entry.4: Perhaps nobody told the fern about the setting.
goldfish.R10.sensor.label: Shaded low-voltage rain sensor
goldfish.R10.sensor.look.1: The measuring surface sits in the warm air from the advertising heater. The sensor can be electrically isolated separately. The connection says LOW VOLTAGE – TEST FUNNEL PERMITTED. The heating line is behind a different cover.
goldfish.R10.diagram.label: Condensation plan and station log
goldfish.R10.diagram.look.1: The plan says: redirect heat from the measuring surface to the safe heat store, measure real moisture, open ventilation in test mode. Text and arrows name each phase. Both historical and current garden data match the visible condensation.
goldfish.R10.tools.label: Umbrella and measuring watering can
goldfish.R10.tools.look.1: The station umbrella is wide and smooth on the inside. According to both labels, the detachable spout of the measuring watering can fits its test holder. The can says: For measurement, not for weather-policy statements.
goldfish.R10.float.label: Safe sight glass with float
goldfish.R10.float.look.1: From our connected habitat we can see the float. Its position is also marked in words: DRY, MEASURING RANGE, OVERFLOW. Nobody has to swim into the weather line.
goldfish.R10.latch.label: Delicate ventilation latch and fern
goldfish.R10.latch.look.1: The latch is caught in the upper guide arch. I can carefully release it once the system is in safe test mode. The fern and misted windows have long been saying the same thing as the garden data.
goldfish.R10.blocked.R09.1: The chosen garden path remains safe.
goldfish.R10.blocked.R11.1: The station is holding the storm in and leaving the depot without power. The documented test mode can safely change both.
goldfish.r10_diagnose.label: Check the fern, measurements and condensation plan together
goldfish.r10_diagnose.line.1: The heater keeps the sensor dry and thereby locks the ventilation. Meanwhile the windows collect the real weather.
goldfish.r10_diagnose.line.2: The fern warns independently of the display. I will help with the latch once you confirm test mode.
goldfish.r10_diagnose.line.3: We will watch the float from our safe connection. Yes, we agree to that.
goldfish.r10_diagnose.line.4: The umbrella and spout belong to the designated test equipment. I will take both for the measuring setup.
goldfish.r10_diagnose.journal.1: The advertising heater fools the rain sensor. The fern and condensation plan confirm this independently. The designated test equipment is available here on both garden routes.
goldfish.r10_funnel.label: Combine the umbrella and watering-can spout into a measuring funnel
goldfish.r10_funnel.line.1: The umbrella is turned upside down. Its retaining ring fits the watering-can spout exactly, as shown on both labels. The result looks like the crown of a very disappointed king.
goldfish.r10_funnel.line.2: An umbrella getting wet on purpose!
goldfish.r10_funnel.line.4: A funnel with an unusual amount of history. I will keep it away from the heating line.
goldfish.r10_install.label: Isolate the low-voltage sensor and fit the test funnel
goldfish.r10_install.line.1: R0ST disconnects only the low-voltage sensor. The designated holder takes the funnel. Measuring current is enabled again for the test; nobody touches the heating circuit.
goldfish.r10_install.line.2: Float in measuring range. No overflow.
goldfish.r10_install.line.3: I am at the latch. Tell me the safe phase and I will release it.
goldfish.r10_install.line.4: The plan remains open. We do not change the weather with a claim.
goldfish.r10_test.label: Carry out the documented test mode with the group
goldfish.r10_test.line.1: Heat moves into the designated store. The measuring surface receives real moisture. Bruno releases the delicate latch, ventilation opens, and the storm breathes out.
goldfish.r10_test.line.2: Measuring range confirmed. And outside: rain! Impossible to miss, but I am saying it anyway.
goldfish.r10_test.line.3: Depot supply restored. Thank you for this meteorologically honest repair.
goldfish.r10_test.line.5: Go ahead and write: We do not always know. Plants can work with that.
goldfish.r10_test.prompt: Put the readable station plan in order. The steps are confirmed individually, with no time pressure.
goldfish.r10_test.option.heat: Safely redirect heat to the heat store
goldfish.r10_test.option.rain: Confirm real moisture in the measuring range
goldfish.r10_test.option.vent: Release the latch and open ventilation in test mode
goldfish.r10_test.wrong.1: First safely move heat away from the measuring surface, then confirm real moisture, and open ventilation last. The fern, written plan and condensation remain visible; we need not guess.
goldfish.r10_test.journal.1: The station measures real moisture again. Heat and ventilation have been safely redirected, and the depot has power. Uncertainty is a useful report; guaranteed false sunshine was not.
goldfish.r10_old_data.label: Compare the historical weather records with the new reading
goldfish.r10_old_data.line.1: The old records show no perfect yearly cycle. Good harvests sit beside bad ones, and small notes in the margin beside large numbers.
goldfish.r10_old_data.line.2: The guarantee would have erased all differences from the chart.
goldfish.r10_old_data.line.3: Alma would first have asked where the wet shoes had gone.
goldfish.r10_old_data.line.4: We will preserve the source too. Otherwise this repair becomes the next polished story.
goldfish.r10_new_data.label: Report the current community measurements back
goldfish.r10_new_data.line.1: The workshop confirms: Our hand measurements now match the station. We will hang the plan beside the lift.
goldfish.r10_new_data.line.2: Then the next person can recognize the fault for themselves.
goldfish.r10_new_data.line.3: A repair that supplies its own instructions.
goldfish.r10_new_data.line.4: I demand a corresponding law for political offices.
goldfish.r10_new_data.line.5: Start with a clearly marked exit.
goldfish.r10_guarantee.label: Read the guarantee all the way to the end
goldfish.r10_guarantee.line.1: The sunshine guarantee applies only with the window closed and actual weather ignored. In case of rain, the definition of sunshine will be updated free of charge.
goldfish.r10_guarantee.line.2: The guarantee protects itself from reality.
goldfish.r10_guarantee.line.3: Someone should give it an umbrella.
goldfish.r10_guarantee.line.4: We have already found that a more useful occupation.
goldfish.P11.title: Sunshine on Command
goldfish.P11.hint.1: The fern and misted windows contradict the sunshine display. A heater is drying the rain sensor, of all things.
goldfish.P11.hint.2: The umbrella and watering-can spout are explicitly labelled as a combined test funnel. Only the low-voltage sensor is isolated; the heating circuit remains protected.
goldfish.P11.hint.3: Inspect the fern and plan, combine the umbrella and spout, use the funnel on the isolated sensor, and with the group carry out redirect heat → confirm moisture → open ventilation.
goldfish.R11.title: Register Depot behind Deep Glass
goldfish.R11.entry.1: Behind glass walls, shelves stand in dark water. Above them lamps drift like tame jellyfish. In front of the dry operating aisle a sign claims: Nothing remains here.
goldfish.R11.entry.4: We read the registers first. My memories stay closed until I decide otherwise.
goldfish.R11.register.label: Merged witness entries
