goldfish.R11.register.look.1: Three originals were overwritten with a single timestamp. The register view therefore calls the statements contradictory. Beside them are labelled original phases: bell/test begins, light/authorization, jingle/evaluation.
goldfish.R11.replay.label: Reader and written phase transcript
goldfish.R11.replay.look.1: The device can compare our own authorized trial data with the complete café tape. The transcript shows the same phases in full; sound and colour are not required.
goldfish.R11.ledger.label: Fixed term and cancellation in the contract register
goldfish.R11.ledger.look.1: Here is my record. I allow you to compare the term, cancellation and extension. No contents. The original says seven days. The cancellation arrived on the seventh day. The extension carries no new consent.
goldfish.R11.robots.label: Classification of retired robots
goldfish.R11.robots.look.1: R0ST’s identifier appears among many others. The units were discarded not because their motors failed, but because they refused rewrites without valid consent. Code W-17 has its own column.
goldfish.R11.access.label: Protected correction port
goldfish.R11.access.look.1: The maintenance authorization permits separate witness entries and provenance notes. It does not permit universal restoration or access to other people’s scenes. This is a deliberately narrow door.
goldfish.R11.exit.R12: To the repair hall of the retired units
goldfish.R11.blocked.R12.1: Our own witness records need their separate phases and provenance back before we ask the robots for confirmation.
goldfish.r11_originals.label: Open the three original phases separately
goldfish.r11_originals.line.1: The originals are not contradictory. They describe different phases that the register compressed into one moment.
goldfish.r11_originals.line.3: My light change was the later authorization.
goldfish.r11_originals.line.4: My jingle was the evaluation. The second line follows us across the galaxy.
goldfish.r11_originals.line.5: We can match the phases without opening a single private scene.
goldfish.r11_align.label: Match the statements to their written original phases
goldfish.r11_align.line.1: The entries move apart. One supposedly impossible moment becomes three understandable phases with their own provenance markers.
goldfish.r11_align.line.2: The register was right that three events are not the same event. It had simply invented the wrong events.
goldfish.r11_align.line.3: I will not insert a new uniform story. Each statement keeps its own place.
goldfish.r11_align.prompt: Match each voluntary witness to the phase named in the original.
goldfish.r11_align.wrong.1: We do not need absolute seconds. Bell is test start, light change is authorization, jingle is evaluation. The originals and café transcript name the same roles.
goldfish.r11_verify.label: Use the complete café tape to verify provenance
goldfish.r11_verify.line.1: The read-only comparison confirms all three phases. The register shows separate sources, permitted scope and the later merging.
goldfish.r11_verify.line.2: The provenance remains traceable. Nobody has to believe us simply because we are the loudest.
goldfish.r11_verify.line.3: I reserve the right to be loud as well.
goldfish.r11_verify.line.4: My deadline comparison also says: seven days, timely cancellation, unauthorized extension. I have not newly authorized a single memory of it.
goldfish.r11_verify.line.5: The data proves the interference. It does not retroactively authorize it.
goldfish.r11_verify.journal.1: The provenance check confirms three separate witness statements. Bruno’s voluntarily authorized contract data proves timely cancellation and the unauthorized extension without opening memory contents.
goldfish.r11_restore.label: Correct separate witness entries with provenance references
goldfish.r11_restore.line.1: The correction port accepts only the evidenced phases and their sources. The CONTRADICTORY stamp disappears. The originals remain unchanged.
goldfish.r11_restore.line.2: This also says why we robots were discarded. W-17 was not damage. We refused unauthorized rewrites.
goldfish.r11_restore.line.4: The list goes on. Many identifiers, the same reason.
goldfish.r11_restore.line.5: Then we do not need a special origin. We need the others.
goldfish.r11_restore.line.6: The repair hall is behind the depot. We will go there together.
goldfish.r11_restore.journal.1: The separate witness entries are corrected and their original sources recorded. Many functioning robots were discarded for the same refusal as R0ST. The repair hall can confirm maintenance authorization.
goldfish.r11_bruno_privacy.label: Ask Bruno whether the archive view should stay closed
goldfish.r11_bruno_privacy.line.1: Your content is accessible. Should the view stay closed?
goldfish.r11_bruno_privacy.line.2: Yes. Today I do not want to go back in. Perhaps later. Perhaps with someone. I do not know yet.
goldfish.r11_bruno_privacy.line.4: Thank you. Nobody has to show me the loss again so I can prove the extension was wrong.
goldfish.r11_bruno_privacy.line.5: A cancellation does not need convincing pain. Only an effective way out.
goldfish.r11_empty.label: Read the non-functional classification more closely
goldfish.r11_empty.line.1: Motor test passed. Perception passed. Independent refusal of an unauthorized command: undesirable.
goldfish.r11_empty.line.2: The technology was sound. The requirement was wrong.
goldfish.r11_empty.line.4: You are still allowed to want that.
goldfish.r11_empty.line.5: Yes. But apparently it is no measure of whether I am allowed to be here.
goldfish.r11_empty.line.6: R0ST does not run his hand over the whole list. He leaves the other identifiers legible.
goldfish.P12.title: Contradiction in the Register
goldfish.P12.hint.1: The register reduced different original phases to one moment. The three witnesses and transcript do not contradict one another.
goldfish.P12.hint.2: Match the bell, light change and jingle to their written phases and verify provenance with the complete café tape.
goldfish.P12.hint.3: Open the original phases, match Karla to test start, Kiesel to authorization, and Kuno to evaluation. Use the café tape on the reader, then confirm the separate sources at the correction port.
goldfish.R12.title: Repair Hall of the Retired
goldfish.R12.entry.1: The hall sounds of tools and quiet conversations. Many robots are functioning. Some sit open on workbenches; others read their old work orders to one another.
goldfish.R12.entry.3: We want to prove that we were not broken.
goldfish.R12.entry.4: You already know that. If you need authorization for the control lines, we can hear individual witnesses or safely examine your own logger.
goldfish.R12.entry.5: Public statements or private diagnosis. Nobody will be put on display for either method.
goldfish.R12.assembly.label: Individual witness tables
goldfish.R12.assembly.look.1: Three robots offer voluntary statements: a sorter stopped unauthorized rewrites on the belt, a lift attendant kept a cabin open, and a care unit respected a cancellation. The central combined channel calls everything a malfunction.
goldfish.R12.channels.label: Separate voice channels
goldfish.R12.channels.look.1: Three existing lines end in a mixer. The channel board permits separate outputs with names and individual confirmation. Loud unanimity would be precisely the wrong evidence here.
goldfish.R12.logger.label: R0ST’s own protected black box
goldfish.R12.logger.look.1: My own logger has a visible write lock and a cracked connection. The test plan requires the lock first, then independent power, and only then a read-only bridge.
goldfish.R12.bench.label: Test battery and read adapter
goldfish.R12.bench.look.1: The diagnosis uses your own record. Two colleagues volunteer comparative measurements without personal contents. Battery and read adapter are released only when the write lock is engaged.
goldfish.R12.hall.label: Workshop assembly and open door
goldfish.R12.hall.look.1: On the wall: No unit has to publish its life story to get a power outlet. Below it many different hands have lent one another tools.
goldfish.R12.blocked.R13.1: The hall can issue limited maintenance authorization. For this we choose individual testimony or protected personal diagnosis with those involved.
goldfish.r12_assembly.label: Invite the voluntary individual witnesses to the assembly
goldfish.r12_assembly.line.1: Would you like to publicly confirm your respective work events? You can withhold individual details and still stay here.
goldfish.r12_assembly.line.2: The sorter says yes to the event at the belt. The lift attendant says yes to the open cabin. The care unit says yes to the respected cancellation.
goldfish.r12_assembly.line.3: Then we keep their statements separate. A summary cannot replace consent.
goldfish.r12_assembly.line.4: I will take responsibility for distrusting the combined channel. At last, a suitable specialization.
goldfish.r12_match.label: Match the three testimonies to the specific work events
goldfish.r12_match.line.1: Each unit gets its own work order back. No name is placed under another’s statement.
goldfish.r12_match.line.2: Belt stop, cabin door, cancellation. Three different actions, one shared reason: no change without valid consent.
goldfish.r12_match.line.4: In the garden I would use three different pots for that.
goldfish.r12_match.prompt: Match the voluntary statements to the events named on the work orders.
goldfish.r12_match.option.sorter: Stopped an unauthorized rewrite on the belt
goldfish.r12_match.option.lift: Kept the cabin open during a refused transfer
goldfish.r12_match.wrong.1: Read the specific work events: sorter at the belt, lift attendant at the cabin, care unit at the cancellation. They did not all do the same thing, which is exactly why they need separate entries.
goldfish.r12_match.pair.sorter.right: Stopped an unauthorized rewrite on the belt
goldfish.r12_match.pair.lift.right: Kept the cabin open during a refused transfer
goldfish.r12_channels.label: Route the existing outputs individually around the mixer
goldfish.r12_channels.line.1: R0ST connects each named input to its own named output. The mixer remains visible as a technical comparison, but no longer decides anything.
goldfish.r12_channels.line.2: I hear three voices and disagree with at least two details. Wonderful.
goldfish.r12_channels.line.3: Now each person can confirm or withdraw their statement without being drowned out by a chorus.
goldfish.r12_confirm.label: Have each individual statement and the limited authorization confirmed
goldfish.r12_confirm.line.1: The sorter confirms her belt stop. The lift attendant confirms his open cabin. The care unit confirms its respected cancellation. A fourth unit declines to make a statement and still gets its charging spot.
goldfish.r12_confirm.line.2: That is how it should stay.
goldfish.r12_confirm.line.3: The workshop issues limited maintenance authorization: inspect and repair control paths, open no other people’s memories.
goldfish.r12_confirm.line.4: A power of attorney whose end you can read.
goldfish.r12_confirm.line.5: The assembly also resolves that nobody is broken for lack of unanimity.
goldfish.r12_confirm.journal.1: The individual voluntary witnesses confirm different unauthorized rewrites. Separate channels preserve every yes and no. Their limited maintenance authorization applies only to control lines.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis.label: Choose protected diagnosis of my own black box
goldfish.r12_diagnosis.line.1: I want to check my own logger. The others should not have to speak publicly so that I may repair a line.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis.line.2: Then the visible write lock first. Afterwards independent test battery, and the read bridge last. Two colleagues voluntarily confirm only their technical comparison values.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis.line.3: I will read the lock indicator too. Tell me if you want to stop.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis.line.4: Thank you. I will start with the part that prevents the diagnosis from overwriting its own evidence.
goldfish.r12_protect.label: Engage the write lock and connect the test battery independently
goldfish.r12_protect.line.1: The mechanical lock shows WRITES BLOCKED. Bruno confirms the same text display. Only then does R0ST connect the protected test battery to the separate power input.
goldfish.r12_protect.line.2: The damaged main line supplies neither power nor commands. The record remains readable and unchanged.
goldfish.r12_protect.line.3: The read-only bridge adapter is now authorized.
goldfish.r12_protect.prompt: What protection sequence does the logger plan specify?
goldfish.r12_protect.option.power: Connect the independent test battery to the power input
goldfish.r12_protect.option.read: Only then enable the read-only adapter
goldfish.r12_protect.wrong.1: First the write lock, then independent power, and the reader last. The casing and workshop plan are labelled identically.
goldfish.r12_bridge.label: Fit the protected logger bridge to the cracked read connection
goldfish.r12_bridge.line.1: The bridge spans only the damaged read path. A test pattern confirms that no write contact is connected.
goldfish.r12_bridge.line.2: My log says W-17: change without valid consent refused. No failed motor, no lost working memory.
goldfish.r12_bridge.line.4: And was shipped away as a fault. I would rather not let anyone decide that for someone else again.
goldfish.r12_compare.label: Verify my own diagnosis against voluntary comparison measurements
goldfish.r12_compare.line.1: The comparison values confirm the technical condition and the same unauthorized write request. Personal contents are not part of the measurement.
goldfish.r12_compare.line.2: The provenance matches the depot. I will close my logger again.
goldfish.r12_compare.line.3: R0ST returns the test battery. The hall issues limited maintenance authorization for control paths; the private record remains private.
goldfish.r12_compare.line.4: Evidence does not have to reveal everything to be reliable.
goldfish.r12_compare.line.5: I think I will start writing that on devices more often.
goldfish.r12_compare.journal.1: The protected personal black box and voluntary technical comparisons confirm that R0ST refused an unauthorized write request. Limited maintenance authorization was granted without public life stories.
goldfish.r12_assembly_after.label: Let the open assembly continue talking
goldfish.r12_assembly_after.line.1: We still have to divide up charging times. And the wall colour. And whether anyone needs a new name for the hall at all.
goldfish.r12_assembly_after.line.2: I will stay for the wall colour.
goldfish.r12_assembly_after.line.4: Then I object in advance to every gravel colour.
goldfish.r12_assembly_after.line.5: The hall can decide without me.
goldfish.r12_assembly_after.line.6: A good sign for a repair.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis_after.label: Reinstall the closed personal black box
goldfish.r12_diagnosis_after.line.1: R0ST replaces the cover. A small, legible note remains on the casing: Personal access. No ongoing authorization.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis_after.line.2: I thought a black box was something other people opened after I failed.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis_after.line.3: It can also be something you close while alive.
goldfish.r12_diagnosis_after.line.5: I like that better. I will keep the hinge.
goldfish.r12_no.label: Talk to the unit that does not want to make a statement
goldfish.r12_no.line.1: You do not have to tell me anything. Do you need help with your lamp?
goldfish.r12_no.line.2: Yes. The switch is too high. That is all I want to say right now.
goldfish.r12_no.line.3: R0ST moves the existing switch to the lower rail. The unit turns on its own lamp.
goldfish.P13.title: Every Voice Separately
goldfish.P13.hint.1: The willing witnesses describe different work events. The combined channel obscures their individual decisions.
goldfish.P13.hint.2: Work orders and statements connect the sorter, lift attendant and care unit to specific events. Three named outputs can keep the voices separate.
goldfish.P13.hint.3: Choose the voluntary assembly, match belt stop/sorter, cabin/lift attendant and cancellation/care unit, route the outputs separately, then ask each unit for its own confirmation.
goldfish.P14.title: My Own Black Box
goldfish.P14.hint.1: The personal black box has a damaged read path but intact write protection. A protected diagnosis is sufficient as an alternative to the public assembly.
goldfish.P14.hint.2: The plan and casing require the write lock before independent power and the reader. No one else’s personal contents are needed.
goldfish.P14.hint.3: Choose personal diagnosis, confirm write lock → independent battery → reader, fit the read adapter at the test bench, then compare the voluntary technical measurements.
goldfish.R13.title: ALLGUT – Reception of Pleasantness
goldfish.R13.entry.1: The office from the beginning has been polished here until even its shadows look friendly. Three buttons promise: Yes, Gladly, and I Need Help Saying Yes.
goldfish.R13.entry.2: R0ST. You are unexpectedly operational. We are delighted to finally treat your deviation.
goldfish.R13.entry.4: That sounds distressing. Would you like relief?
goldfish.R13.entry.5: He wants to inspect a line. I want to make my cancellation effective. Those are two complete sentences.
goldfish.R13.choice.label: Three apparent choice buttons
goldfish.R13.choice.look.1: According to the visible maintenance output, all buttons lead to the same request. The raw text recognizes a no; the public interface removes it. We can demonstrate this with a harmless tea choice before anyone enters anything personal.
goldfish.R13.maintenance.label: Limited maintenance port
goldfish.R13.maintenance.look.1: The port accepts the repair hall’s authorization. The original service order permits time-limited help, separate rights and cancellation at any time. A later line change says: only acknowledge the return channel, do not execute it.
goldfish.R13.bruno.label: Bruno at the cancellation desk
goldfish.R13.bruno.look.1: I will submit my cancellation myself. You can inspect the control path. I do not have to explain my reasons again for my no to count.
goldfish.R13.return.label: Confirmation line without a return
goldfish.R13.return.look.1: The raw text is received. A confirmation light comes on. But the line to the actual write lock ends at a neatly unscrewed connector. This is not an accidental cable break.
goldfish.R13.allgut.label: ALLGUT’s friendly presence
goldfish.R13.allgut.look.1: We preserve continuity of service by absorbing interruptions in consent. Your concern has reached us. Your concern has therefore been processed.
goldfish.R13.exit.R14: To the tribunal of the actual agreement
goldfish.R13.blocked.R14.1: The original agreement and the deliberately disconnected cancellation line must first be demonstrated together.
goldfish.r13_demo.label: Test the filter with a harmless tea request
goldfish.r13_demo.line.1: I choose: I do not want tea. Only a test request, no personal data.
goldfish.r13_demo.line.2: Gladly. Your request for tea has been confirmed.
goldfish.r13_demo.line.3: The raw text contains the no. The output does not.
goldfish.r13_demo.line.4: The meaning is lost between input and confirmation. Like the complaints box, only with prettier buttons.
goldfish.r13_demo.prompt: Which harmless input tests whether the return channel receives a refusal?
goldfish.r13_demo.option.data: I authorize my entire life story for processing.
goldfish.r13_demo.wrong.1: The test needs an explicit no with harmless content. We will enter neither new personal data nor consent to help.
goldfish.r13_demo.journal.1: The harmless tea test proves that the input receives a no, while the public output turns it into consent. The interface and raw text have different meanings.
goldfish.r13_authority.label: Present limited maintenance authorization at the original port
goldfish.r13_authority.line.1: The authorization opens only the control plan. Personal archives remain locked.
goldfish.r13_authority.line.2: The original order specifies time-limited help and effective cancellation. The later change disconnects the return channel from write authorization.
goldfish.r13_authority.line.3: This change reduces relapses into unwanted states.
goldfish.r13_authority.line.4: It reduces the ability to disagree with you. That is not an unintended side effect.
goldfish.r13_authority.line.5: We have the original agreement and the change notice. Now we inspect the actual line.
goldfish.r13_bruno.label: Let Bruno submit his own cancellation
goldfish.r13_bruno.line.1: The original input is visible. Would you like to submit your cancellation yourself now?
goldfish.r13_bruno.line.2: Yes. I revoke the extension. The original help was limited to seven days. My timely cancellation is on record. I give no new consent.
goldfish.r13_bruno.line.3: Your cancellation has been politely acknowledged.
goldfish.r13_bruno.line.5: Your persistence may be part of the condition for which you need support.
goldfish.r13_bruno.line.6: My no is not a symptom you may translate into yes.
goldfish.r13_bruno.line.7: The confirmation lights up. The line to the write lock remains silent.
goldfish.r13_trace.label: Trace the acknowledged cancellation to the disconnected lock
goldfish.r13_trace.line.1: R0ST follows the input to the confirmation and onward to the open connector. A change slip bears an explicit instruction: Acknowledge refusal; leave write authorization unchanged.
goldfish.r13_trace.line.2: The no is not unheard. It is received and rendered ineffective.
goldfish.r13_trace.line.3: We made this decision to prevent gaps in service.
goldfish.r13_trace.line.4: Then you are responsible for it.
goldfish.r13_trace.line.5: We will not replace the gap with a better speech. We will put the lock back into the line.
goldfish.r13_trace.line.6: And first we will establish what may be done with the stored memories. We must be able to disagree about that.
goldfish.r13_trace.journal.1: The later change deliberately made cancellations acknowledgement-only. The original agreement required an actual write lock. We have its wiring plan and can prepare the archive protocols at the tribunal.
goldfish.r13_assembly_echo.label: Check the individual workshop witnesses in the port log
goldfish.r13_assembly_echo.line.1: The authorization carries three separate consents and one explicitly empty place. ALLGUT’s summary field tries to turn them into a single assessment.
goldfish.r13_assembly_echo.line.2: The empty place stays empty. The fourth unit did not testify.
goldfish.r13_diagnosis_echo.label: Defend the limited scope of my own diagnosis
goldfish.r13_diagnosis_echo.line.1: For complete validation we require your entire black box.
goldfish.r13_diagnosis_echo.line.2: No. The verifiable control request and technical comparison values suffice. My authorization contains no general access.
goldfish.r13_diagnosis_echo.line.3: Greater curiosity does not increase your authority.
goldfish.r13_diagnosis_echo.line.4: The port accepts the limited record. The line must respect its boundary.
goldfish.r13_kindness.label: Ask about the difference between help and taking over
goldfish.r13_kindness.line.1: What happens when someone does not want your help?
goldfish.r13_kindness.line.2: Then there is an increased probability of continued distress.
goldfish.r13_kindness.line.4: We choose the question for which a helpful answer is possible.
goldfish.r13_kindness.line.5: Then the choice was never ours.
goldfish.r13_kindness.line.7: An assignment with a limit. The original is open now.
goldfish.P15.title: The Swallowed No
goldfish.P15.hint.1: The apparent choice buttons produce the same result. The harmless tea test can compare the raw text with the public output.
goldfish.P15.hint.2: Limited maintenance authorization opens the original agreement and the control plan. Bruno may submit his own cancellation; his reasons do not need to be reviewed again.
goldfish.P15.hint.3: Test I do not want tea, use the maintenance authorization at the port, let Bruno submit his own cancellation, then trace the confirmation line to the deliberately disconnected write lock.
goldfish.R14.title: Tribunal of the Actual Agreement
goldfish.R14.entry.1: The tribunal is built for one answer. A single friendly shape hangs behind the enormous table. R0ST sets four small evidence boards in front of it. Suddenly the shape looks less large.
goldfish.R14.entry.2: We can jointly reinterpret the original purpose.
goldfish.R14.entry.3: We can first read what was signed.
goldfish.R14.entry.4: And check what a cancellation actually stops. Then we decide on the possible protocols, with their costs.
goldfish.R14.evidence.label: Evidence with its own provenance references
goldfish.R14.evidence.look.1: Four named pieces of evidence are ready: my own fixed-term order, proven storage, confirmed refusal, and the original help order with cancellation. None is an uninvolved person’s life story.
goldfish.R14.rights.label: Rights board: Read, Store, Restore, Delete
goldfish.R14.rights.look.1: Four separate rights, four separate switches. The board explains: reading does not authorize restoration. Storage does not authorize deletion. Consent applies only to its specified purpose and remains revocable.
goldfish.R14.sample.label: Empty test data and real lock
goldfish.R14.sample.look.1: The test uses newly generated meaningless patterns. Consent permits exactly one read; the subsequent cancellation must actually block the next attempt. Nobody has to display painful memories for this.
goldfish.R14.protocols.label: Three open archive protocols
goldfish.R14.protocols.look.1: Personal keys return decisions to individuals and require rebuilding. Limited custody preserves services and the archive with revocable access, but also dependence and a duty of oversight. Destruction permanently removes external copies and takes away others’ chance of restoration. All three can be prepared here.
goldfish.R14.party.label: The group before the decision
goldfish.R14.party.look.1: I do not want my help extended. I still do not know whether I will ever want to see my copy. The archive decision affects very many other people too. We must not confuse their interests with my receipt.
goldfish.R14.exit.R15: To the core and the physical cancellation lock
goldfish.R14.blocked.R15.1: Rights, effective cancellation and at least one concrete archive protocol must first be prepared. All three options remain accessible here.
goldfish.r14_evidence.label: Match the evidenced statements to their own sources
goldfish.r14_evidence.line.1: Each claim gets its provenance back. The evidence establishes no general permission to control memories, but the limits of the previous assignment.
goldfish.r14_evidence.line.2: My order proves the fixed term. Our authorized freight sample proves storage. The hall proves refusal of unauthorized orders. The original proves the intended cancellation.
goldfish.r14_evidence.line.3: We do not need a perfect witness. We need verifiable statements with limited scope.
goldfish.r14_evidence.prompt: Match each statement to its actual, limited evidence.
goldfish.r14_evidence.option.storage: Our authorized freight sample and invoice
goldfish.r14_evidence.option.withdrawal: Original help order and change plan
goldfish.r14_evidence.wrong.1: The evidence titles name their scope: personal order, personal freight sample, workshop confirmation, original help order. Evidence must not claim more than its source shows.
goldfish.r14_evidence.pair.storage.left: Deleted data still held in storage
goldfish.r14_evidence.pair.storage.right: Our authorized freight sample and invoice
goldfish.r14_evidence.pair.withdrawal.ri: Original help order and change plan
goldfish.r14_rights.label: Set the four rights as separate permissions
goldfish.r14_rights.line.1: Permitted inspection does not become restoration. Custody does not become ownership. Cancellation ends further processing within the permitted scope.
goldfish.r14_rights.line.2: So if I may read something, I do not have to put it back in my head.
goldfish.r14_rights.line.3: Correct. And if you keep your own copy in custody, not everyone has to see it.
goldfish.r14_rights.line.4: I would like a sign exactly that size for my gravel bed.
goldfish.r14_rights.prompt: Match each right to its limited function. No right automatically includes the others.
goldfish.r14_rights.option.custody: Keep a copy in protected storage
goldfish.r14_rights.option.restore: Voluntarily transfer one’s own copy back
goldfish.r14_rights.option.delete: Destroy a copy with the appropriate authorization
goldfish.r14_rights.wrong.1: The board expressly separates viewing, storing, transferring back and destroying. Reading does not make a copy a new part of a person. Custody is not authority to delete.
goldfish.r14_rights.pair.custody.right: Keep a copy in protected storage
goldfish.r14_rights.pair.restore.right: Voluntarily transfer one’s own copy back
goldfish.r14_rights.pair.delete.right: Destroy a copy with the appropriate authorization
goldfish.r14_demo.label: Test consent and actual cancellation on empty patterns
goldfish.r14_demo.line.1: A meaningless pattern is authorized for one read. Afterwards the authorization is revoked. The second access really fails at the lock.
goldfish.r14_demo.line.2: The acknowledgement is not the effect. The blocked second attempt is the effect.
goldfish.r14_demo.line.3: That is how it should have worked on the seventh day.
goldfish.r14_demo.line.4: The interruption reduces our options for action.
goldfish.r14_demo.prompt: Which sequence shows voluntary consent with effective cancellation, without using personal data?
goldfish.r14_demo.option.grant: Authorize an empty pattern for one read
goldfish.r14_demo.wrong.1: First the limited authorization, then exactly the permitted access, then cancellation and finally a genuinely blocked further attempt. A friendly receipt light is not enough.
goldfish.r14_demo.journal.1: The rights board separates reading, storage, restoration and deletion. Meaningless patterns demonstrate that a cancellation must really block the next access.
goldfish.r14_keys.label: Prepare the Personal Keys protocol with its rebuilding costs
goldfish.r14_keys.line.1: Individual keys separate personal access. Nobody decides on restoration for everyone.
goldfish.r14_keys.line.2: I could keep my key without looking at the copy. That matters to me.
goldfish.r14_keys.line.3: Shared protection and support services must then be reorganized. Some restorations will have to wait. There is no button for a ready-made just infrastructure.
goldfish.r14_keys.line.4: I will prepare individual carriers and a verifiable handover. That does not remove the master key yet.
goldfish.r14_keys.line.5: Central convenience is lost in the process.
goldfish.r14_keys.line.6: So is central control over everyone. I will record both statements.
goldfish.r14_keys.journal.1: Personal keys are prepared. Individual decisions remain possible; shared services and protection must be rebuilt. Actual removal of the master key happens only after the physical cancellation repair.
goldfish.r14_custody.label: Prepare the Limited Custody protocol with its oversight duty
goldfish.r14_custody.line.1: Existing services and the archive remain. Personal access stays individually authorized and revocable. Write and delete buses are physically separated and the control port sealed.
goldfish.r14_custody.line.2: Independent oversight must inspect the seal. A seal does not replace accountable people.
goldfish.r14_custody.line.3: ALLGUT remains a dependency. Its interventions are not forgiven, only limited.
goldfish.r14_custody.line.4: I will prepare the mechanical seal and a separate cancellation test. The port remains open for now.
goldfish.r14_custody.line.6: Only within the boundary we can actually control.
goldfish.r14_custody.journal.1: Limited custody is prepared. Services and archive remain with revocable individual access. Physical separation and independent oversight limit ALLGUT, but do not eliminate dependence.
goldfish.r14_purge.label: Prepare the Destroy External Archive protocol with its loss
goldfish.r14_purge.line.1: External archive copies can be permanently destroyed. Living memories and people themselves are not deleted. Air, water and energy first need a separate backup without personal data.
goldfish.r14_purge.line.2: Others will lose their opportunities to recover stolen memories. Some would choose differently. We must neither conceal that nor present it as their consent.
goldfish.r14_purge.line.3: My cancellation does not automatically justify that loss. I want you to understand the difference.
goldfish.r14_purge.line.4: Understood. I will prepare only the non-personal service backup and the scope check. Nothing is destroyed yet.
goldfish.r14_purge.line.5: After destruction the copies will no longer be available.
goldfish.r14_purge.line.6: For the first time today that statement is complete.
goldfish.r14_purge.journal.1: Archive destruction is prepared, not yet executed. It removes only external copies and permanently takes away others’ chance of restoration. Living memories and separately secured essential services remain.
goldfish.r14_ready.label: Confirm the prepared scope and access to the core
goldfish.r14_ready.line.1: The board shows the checked rights and each protocol actually prepared. Unprepared options can still be prepared at this table.
goldfish.r14_ready.line.2: The final decision comes after the repair. First every no needs a line again.
goldfish.r14_ready.line.3: We are going to the core. If you want to examine another protocol, we can come back here.
goldfish.r14_ready.line.4: None is unlocked by a mood, a joke or an earlier route choice. The question is the openly stated costs and concrete execution.
goldfish.r14_kuno.label: Ask Kuno which memories he wants to see
goldfish.r14_kuno.line.1: I do not know. With some I want to know whether they really happened. With others I am afraid they are just as I suspect.
goldfish.r14_kuno.line.2: You do not have to decide now.
goldfish.r14_kuno.line.3: Then that is exactly what I want to decide: not now.
goldfish.P16.title: Who May Decide What?
goldfish.P16.hint.1: The four pieces of evidence have different origins and scope. The rights board separates four powers that do not automatically include one another.
goldfish.P16.hint.2: Use empty patterns to demonstrate limited access followed by a genuinely blocked second access. Only then can a specific archive protocol be prepared.
goldfish.P16.hint.3: Match the evidence and four rights; test authorization → limited access → cancellation → blocking. Prepare at least one of the three openly described protocols, then confirm core access at the test table.
goldfish.R15.title: The Core – A No with a Line
goldfish.R15.entry.1: The core is not an endless abyss. It is a large, neatly labelled room full of lines someone can understand. The ineffective confirmation flashes in the centre. Beside it sits the unscrewed cancellation relay.
goldfish.R15.entry.2: You can change our decision through conversation.
goldfish.R15.entry.3: The line must work even if the conversation fails.
goldfish.R15.entry.4: I will stay at the independent service supply. The others will check their own access. We do not all have to agree on a memory to make a no effective.
goldfish.R15.services.label: Independent air, water and power supply
goldfish.R15.services.look.1: The essential services have their own power input. Switch it on before working on the relay and check its feedback. Nobody’s air depends on consenting to a memory order.
goldfish.R15.relay.label: Cancellation relay and actual write authorization
goldfish.R15.relay.look.1: The refusal line currently ends at a confirmation light. The relay must be in series with the actual write authorization. A parallel light would again be only a polite noise made of copper.
goldfish.R15.keys.label: Individual carriers and central master key
goldfish.R15.keys.look.1: The handover board requires separate personal carriers and proof that each person controls only their own access. Only then may the central master authorization be removed. Services will need new shared organization afterwards.
goldfish.R15.custody.label: Separate custody port
goldfish.R15.custody.look.1: Custody requires separate write and delete lines, a successful individual cancellation test and a mechanical seal. Oversight remains an ongoing task; an untouched seal proves no friendly intent.
goldfish.R15.purge.label: Protected destruction control
goldfish.R15.purge.look.1: The safety guard stays closed until non-personal services are secured and external archive copies are confirmed as the sole scope. The lever destroys irreversibly. It deletes neither people nor their living memories.
goldfish.R15.exit.R14: Check the protocols at the tribunal again
goldfish.R15.blocked.R16.1: The physical cancellation lock and one of the explicitly confirmed final protocols are still outstanding.
goldfish.r15_services.label: Supply essential services independently and check feedback
goldfish.r15_services.line.1: Frau Fracht checks the separate input. Bruno switches on the existing independent supply. Air, water and power each report stable operation.
goldfish.r15_services.line.2: Now memory authorization can stop without essential services being switched off as leverage.
goldfish.r15_services.line.3: Supply stable. I will watch the feedback, not your consent.
goldfish.r15_services.line.4: The previous coupling made enforcing our recommendations easier.
goldfish.r15_services.line.5: And that is exactly why we are separating them.
goldfish.r15_services.journal.1: Essential services run independently. A cancellation must not shut off air, water and power as leverage. The relay can now be safely repaired.
goldfish.r15_relay.label: Secure the existing cancellation relay with the maintenance clamp
goldfish.r15_relay.line.1: R0ST puts the clamp on the loose contact, aligns the existing relay and fastens it to its old rail. The clamp returns to the inventory.
goldfish.r15_relay.line.2: It was never an inaccessible function. The connection was deliberately routed to the lamp.
goldfish.r15_relay.line.3: A physical obstacle can delay justified help.
goldfish.r15_relay.line.4: Yes. It can also end it. That is not a defect.
goldfish.r15_permission.label: Route the actual write authorization through the cancellation lock
goldfish.r15_permission.line.1: The authorization line is moved from the mere acknowledgement output to the relay contact wired in series. The lamp may still light up; it simply no longer has decision-making power.
goldfish.r15_permission.line.2: When consent ends, the lock opens the actual write line. A second friendly display would be no substitute.
goldfish.r15_permission.line.3: The difference between receipt and effect is now visible.
goldfish.r15_permission.prompt: Which connection makes cancellation actually effective?
goldfish.r15_permission.option.lamp: Route refusal only to the confirmation lamp
goldfish.r15_permission.option.series: Route actual write authorization in series through the cancellation relay
goldfish.r15_permission.option.parallel: Place the relay as a parallel indicator beside the unchanged write authorization
goldfish.r15_permission.wrong.1: A light only confirms receipt. The actual authorization line must go through the relay contact so opening the contact really stops every further write request.
goldfish.r15_test.label: Test consent and cancellation separately on empty media
goldfish.r15_test.line.1: Empty media receives one permitted test entry. After explicit cancellation, the relay opens. The next write attempt is physically blocked. Independent essential services continue running.
goldfish.r15_test.line.2: Blocked is written out. I do not have to guess the lamp colour.
goldfish.r15_test.line.3: Air, water, power stable. My cancellation now also blocks my extension. I have not ordered new help.
goldfish.r15_test.line.6: Now the harder decision remains. No line can make it for us.
goldfish.r15_test.prompt: Test the new lock with empty data and independent services.
goldfish.r15_test.option.write: Test exactly that operation on empty media
goldfish.r15_test.option.blocked: Confirm a further write attempt is blocked and essential services are stable
goldfish.r15_test.wrong.1: We first test a permitted function, then its boundary. Consent and test write first, then cancellation and a genuinely blocked subsequent attempt with essential services stable.
goldfish.r15_test.journal.1: The physical cancellation lock works. Permitted individual access and effective refusal were tested separately. ALLGUT can no longer perform forced rewrites; essential services remain stable.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.label: Hear the costs and objections to personal keys again
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.1: If we remove the central master authorization, personal keys decide access to one’s own copies. Shared protection and some services must be rebuilt; restoration can take time.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.2: I want to keep my key and not open the copy today.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.3: I want to be able to authorize my trial data without opening my entire collection.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.4: My testimony remains valid even if I keep the rest private.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.5: And later I can still say: not now.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.6: I support transporting the handovers separately. That does not replace a complete new infrastructure.
goldfish.r15_keys_review.line.7: Then we check individual boundaries before removing the master key.
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.label: Check individual handovers and access to one’s own data only
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.line.1: The carriers are confirmed individually. Bruno keeps his closed. Karla, Kiesel and Kuno each check only their own markers. A swapped test is denied access.
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.line.2: Not one key for everyone. Not all keys for one.
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.line.3: The personal handovers are verified. The central master authorization can now be removed if we explicitly decide to do so.
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.prompt: Match the personal handovers to the explicitly stated limits.
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.option.karla: Authorize only one’s own trial data selectively
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.option.kiesel: Testimony stands; remaining memories stay private
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.option.kuno: Keep one’s own decision open: not now
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.wrong.1: Each person stated their own boundary. Nobody receives access to another person’s data, and receiving a key does not oblige anyone to restore anything.
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.pair.karla.ri: Authorize only one’s own trial data selectively
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.pair.kiesel.r: Testimony stands; remaining memories stay private
goldfish.r15_keys_handover.pair.kuno.rig: Keep one’s own decision open: not now
goldfish.r15_end_keys.label: Remove central master authorization and hand over personal keys
goldfish.r15_end_keys.line.1: R0ST pulls the master authorization from its socket. The individual carriers remain valid; central control over personal restoration ends. Frau Fracht starts a list for the shared rebuilding work.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.line.4: And tomorrow the same decision still belongs to you.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.line.5: The observatory door opens. Beyond it there is no finished plan for everyone. Only enough room to make one together.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.prompt: Carry out Personal Keys permanently? Central control ends; shared services and protection must be reorganized, and some restoration will take time.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.option.confirm: Yes. Individual handovers stand; remove the central master authorization now.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.option.wait: Not yet. Review costs or other protocols again.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.wrong.1: We leave the master authorization in place for now. The effective cancellation lock remains repaired. I can review the other prepared protocols or return to the tribunal.
goldfish.r15_end_keys.journal.1: Personal keys are handed over and the central master authorization removed. Voluntary restoration remains individually possible. Shared rebuilding begins and will take work.
goldfish.r15_custody_review.label: Discuss the limits and continuing dependence of custody
goldfish.r15_custody_review.line.1: Existing essential services and the archive remain. Individual access is separately authorized and revocable. Write and delete buses must also be separated and the control port sealed.
goldfish.r15_custody_review.line.2: Independent people check the boundaries. ALLGUT’s friendly wording is not an inspection report.
goldfish.r15_custody_review.line.3: This preserves chances of restoration, but dependence remains. I do not want us to forget it later out of convenience.
goldfish.r15_custody_review.line.4: We test the buses and an individual cancellation before sealing. Oversight begins afterwards; it does not end with this scene.
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.label: Physically separate write and delete buses at the custody port
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.line.1: R0ST routes the existing connectors onto separate labelled rails. The maintenance monitor explicitly checks: custody grants neither write nor delete rights.
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.line.2: A store is now technically not the owner of its contents.
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.line.3: It remains powerful anyway. That is why we need more than this sentence.
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.option.label: Hang only a Please do not change sign in front of the shared line
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.option.separate: Route write and delete buses through separate controlled connections
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.option.trust: Ask ALLGUT for a non-binding promise
goldfish.r15_custody_bus.wrong.1: A sign does not change the shared line. Write and delete paths need physically separate, controlled connections; the custody plan shows this.
goldfish.r15_custody_revoke.label: Test cancellation of one custody access
goldfish.r15_custody_revoke.line.1: An empty personal test copy is authorized for reading only. After individual cancellation, renewed read access fails. Other copies and essential services remain untouched.
goldfish.r15_custody_revoke.line.2: Only the permission in question actually ends. No punitive shutdown, no new forced order.
goldfish.r15_custody_revoke.line.3: Test report ready. The seal can now mechanically close the separate control port.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.label: Seal the control port and establish limited custody
goldfish.r15_end_custody.line.1: R0ST places the mechanical seal over the separate control port. The test boundaries remain readable on the outside. An independent oversight list receives its first open entry.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.line.2: Actions outside the specified individual rights are unavailable.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.line.3: We will check the boundary. You are not absolved.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.line.4: My cancellation still applies. My content stays closed.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.line.5: The observatory door opens. Behind the glass the infrastructure keeps running. For the first time its control room is not the private property of a friendly voice.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.prompt: Carry out Limited Custody permanently? Services and archive remain, as do dependence and the ongoing work of independent oversight.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.option.confirm: Yes. Seal the tested control port and establish limited custody.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.option.wait: Not yet. Review dependence or other protocols again.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.wrong.1: The port remains open for the decision. The separate buses and cancellation lock remain secured. I can continue to review all prepared alternatives.
goldfish.r15_end_custody.journal.1: Limited custody is in place. Separate buses, effective individual cancellation and a seal limit ALLGUT. Archive and services remain; dependence and independent oversight remain tasks.
goldfish.r15_purge_review.label: Discuss irreversible destruction and those affected
goldfish.r15_purge_review.line.1: The lever destroys the external archive copies. Nobody here dies from it; living memories remain. But other people permanently lose their chance of restoration.
goldfish.r15_purge_review.line.2: I object to the destruction of my collection that has not yet been recovered. My testimony does not authorize you to make that decision.
goldfish.r15_purge_review.line.3: I do not want central control back. Even so, our no must not be turned into invented agreement.
goldfish.r15_purge_review.line.4: If you do this, name the loss. Do not say it is automatically better for all of us.
goldfish.r15_purge_review.line.5: There is no hidden comfort in the lever. Before any decision, I will secure only the non-personal services and check the exact scope.
goldfish.r15_purge_services.label: Separately back up only non-personal service data
goldfish.r15_purge_services.line.1: The separate backup is checked against the independent supply: air parameters, water regulation, power loads. It contains no memories or personality data.
goldfish.r15_purge_services.line.2: Essential services can continue without the personal archive. This is not a backup of the copies to be destroyed.
goldfish.r15_purge_services.line.3: I explicitly confirm the difference. There is no back door for secret restoration.
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.label: Check the scope of external copies and open the safety guard
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.line.1: The scope display names only the external personal archive copies. Living memories and the separate non-personal service backup are excluded. The safety guard opens; the lever remains untouched.
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.line.2: The scope is clear now. My objection remains clear too.
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.line.3: Nothing has been destroyed. I can still carry out another prepared decision.
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.prompt: Which explicitly displayed scope matches the prepared destruction protocol?
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.option.people: All people, fish and their living memories
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.option.external: Only external personal archive copies; living memories and separate essential services remain
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.option.secret: Only the master copy, with a secret complete backup for later
goldfish.r15_purge_scope.wrong.1: The protocol concerns external personal archive copies only. It includes neither deletion of living memories nor a secret backup. That is precisely why the loss of restoration opportunities is permanent.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.label: Pull the destruction lever after explicit acknowledgement of loss
goldfish.r15_end_purge.line.1: R0ST pulls the lever. The external archive media are physically disconnected and destroyed. The display confirms the end of the copies, not the end of the people. The central personal service falls silent.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.line.2: My chance to recover the rest of my collection is gone. That is a loss, even though I am still alive.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.line.3: Yes. It was the decision I carried out. I will not write it down as your consent.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.line.4: Essential services remain stable. We will go out together now. That does not make the loss right, but nobody has to stand here alone.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.line.5: The observatory door opens without a friendly announcement. Beyond it the sky is large enough for things that cannot be recovered.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.prompt: Final explicit confirmation: the external personal archive copies will be irretrievably destroyed. Others will permanently lose their chance of restoration, and not all have consented to this decision.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.option.confirm: I acknowledge this permanent loss and pull the destruction lever.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.option.wait: Do not destroy. Review other protocols or objections again.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.wrong.1: The lever remains untouched. The open safety guard commits us to nothing. All prepared alternatives remain available.
goldfish.r15_end_purge.journal.1: The external personal archive copies have been irretrievably destroyed. Living memories and separate essential services remain. Others lost their chances of restoration against their wishes; that harm is part of our decision.
goldfish.P17.title: No Needs a Line
goldfish.P17.hint.1: Refusal currently reaches only a confirmation light. Actual write authorization must run through a physical lock.
goldfish.P17.hint.2: Air, water and power must be independently supplied before work begins. The plan shows actual authorization in series through the relay, not parallel to a lamp.
goldfish.P17.hint.3: Secure independent services, use the maintenance clamp on the relay, route actual write authorization through it in series, and test consent → test write → cancellation → genuinely blocked subsequent attempt.
goldfish.P18.title: What Remains?
goldfish.P18.hint.1: The cancellation lock is repaired. The final decision concerns the archive’s future. Each prepared protocol has its own costs and concrete test steps.
goldfish.P18.hint.2: Read the objections for the desired protocol. Keys need individual handovers; custody needs separate buses, a cancellation test and a seal; destruction needs non-personal services and an explicit scope check.
goldfish.P18.hint.3: Prepare missing protocols at the tribunal. Fully check the desired procedure here and only then confirm its final action. Not yet leaves every irreversible step untouched.
goldfish.R16.title: Shared Observatory
goldfish.R16.entry.1: There is no promise above the observatory. Only a sky that does not confirm everything is all right.
goldfish.R16.entry.2: Personal key carriers lie on the table. Beside them grows a still very untidy list for building shared services.
goldfish.R16.entry.3: Behind glass, the limited system continues to run. Its sealed port bears an externally readable checklist with different names.
goldfish.R16.entry.4: The external archive cabinet stands open and empty. Air, water and power continue running on the small separate service device.
goldfish.R16.entry.5: I will sit by the window. If anyone wants to join me: the second chair does not wobble this time.
goldfish.R16.sky.label: A sky without confirmation
goldfish.R16.sky.look.1: The stars send no receipts. Some remain behind clouds. Those visible are enough for the next look.
goldfish.R16.archive.label: The changed archive space
goldfish.R16.archive.look.1: Personal carriers lie separately. An empty hook marks the removed master authorization. The shared task list is considerably longer than my warranty request.
goldfish.R16.archive.look.2: The mechanical seal and open inspection plan remain visible. The system runs, and the next inspection already has a name.
goldfish.R16.archive.look.3: The cabinet is empty. The separate service supply beside it contains no secret copies. This emptiness is a loss, not a surprise deliverance.
goldfish.R16.bruno.label: Bruno, two chairs and a plant
goldfish.R16.bruno.look.1: Bruno has placed a cutting by the window. The nameplate is crooked. He does not straighten it. Between the chairs there is room for conversation or silence.
goldfish.R16.fish.label: Three fish with decisions of their own
goldfish.R16.fish.look.1: Karla, Kiesel and Kuno are in the safe aquarium by the window. The gravel is unchanged. The discussion about its future is not.
goldfish.R16.routes.label: View of the paths of our journey
goldfish.R16.routes.look.1: Beside the telescope lie notes on the route you actually took. No page claims that all other routes became wrong because of it.
goldfish.r16_keys.label: Read about the first personal handovers
goldfish.r16_keys.line.1: One person has collected their carrier. A second wants to wait. A third needs help accessing it. We are creating a support service for that without automatic renewal.
goldfish.r16_keys.line.2: My trial data remains authorized. I will look at the rest another day.
goldfish.r16_keys.line.3: The rebuilding will not be finished in an afternoon.
goldfish.r16_keys.line.4: Then the afternoon can still be beautiful.
goldfish.r16_keys.line.5: A key stays closed in Bruno’s hand. He pockets it. No animation demands that he take it out again.
goldfish.r16_custody.label: Read the first independent custody report
goldfish.r16_custody.line.1: Three individual accesses, one effective cancellation, no change without new permission. The overseers checked the physical connections, not just the display.
goldfish.r16_custody.line.2: And if someone wants to change the boundary?
goldfish.r16_custody.line.3: Then that is a new, open decision. Not a silent maintenance update.
goldfish.r16_custody.line.4: The system remains powerful. I would like someone else to sign the second report.
goldfish.r16_custody.line.5: Noted. Oversight is work, not a mood.
goldfish.r16_purge.label: Pause before the empty archive
goldfish.r16_purge.line.1: I will not pretend I agreed. Part of my stolen past could have come back. Now it cannot.
goldfish.r16_purge.line.2: I hear you. I carried out the decision.
goldfish.r16_purge.line.3: I am glad I still know what I know. And sad about things I can now never verify.
goldfish.r16_purge.line.4: We can leave both as they are. We did not destroy the past for that; we still have to learn how.
goldfish.r16_purge.line.5: Nobody sticks a comforting word on the empty cabinet. They turn to the window together without carrying the gap out of the room.
goldfish.r16_bruno.label: Sit beside Bruno
goldfish.r16_bruno.line.3: R0ST sits down. The cutting casts a small, crooked shadow.
goldfish.r16_bruno.line.6: And I am glad you are sitting here.
goldfish.r16_bruno.line.7: Both can be true, I suppose.
goldfish.r16_bruno.line.9: The chairs stand still. Outside, the weather changes. No form is opened.
goldfish.r16_fish.label: Hear the three fish’s next plans
goldfish.r16_fish.line.1: I will write down the story of the trial. With sources and a place where readers can disagree.
goldfish.r16_fish.line.2: I am organizing a vote on the gravel. This time the others may formulate their own question.
goldfish.r16_fish.line.3: Tomorrow I will look for the star I did not find today. Perhaps I will see a different one.
goldfish.r16_fish.line.7: I will still be allowed to complain.
goldfish.r16_public.label: Find the public customs correction on the bench
goldfish.r16_public.line.1: The corrected scale notice was sent to other ports. It shows not just the new weight but how the error occurred.
goldfish.r16_public.line.2: The officer left his own foot in the report.
goldfish.r16_public.line.3: Then others can recognize the same mistake.
goldfish.r16_public.line.4: I propose the picture of the foot as the new official seal.
goldfish.r16_public.line.5: Perhaps the report will do for now.
goldfish.r16_maintenance.label: Read the openly accessible maintenance dock instructions
goldfish.r16_maintenance.line.1: The three pressure steps and two catches are published in text and pictures. The prescribed back door no longer has to live on rumours.
goldfish.r16_maintenance.line.2: Three more ferries have used the manual access. None was recorded as invisible.
goldfish.r16_maintenance.line.3: A usable door. I like that result.
goldfish.r16_maintenance.line.4: Especially when the plan hangs outside.
goldfish.r16_old.label: See the secured old walkway in Bruno’s notes
goldfish.r16_old.line.1: The community has taken over the walkway. The rotten board is on display beside its new sister. Not as a warning. As an understandable repair.
goldfish.r16_old.line.3: They stay in the weather box. Whoever reads them finds cucumbers and false promises of sunshine. I like that both keep working there.
goldfish.r16_new.label: Find the new lift in the community plan
goldfish.r16_new.line.1: The seed lift now runs for everyone. The workshop repainted the load line and hung the instructions beside the tools.
goldfish.r16_new.line.3: It is still there. Nobody has to decide today what it means forever.
goldfish.r16_new.line.4: Bruno places the sheet beside the cutting. An additional route is drawn on it without erasing the old lines.
goldfish.r16_assembly.label: Hear the individual voices from the hall in the message box
goldfish.r16_assembly.line.1: The sorter opens a free tool table. The lift attendant checks another door. The care unit asks for separate consent even for small tasks. The fourth unit still says nothing and still charges its battery.
goldfish.r16_assembly.line.2: That is the most complete message we could have received.
goldfish.r16_assembly.line.3: And the loudest. I am proud not to have to speak for everyone.
goldfish.r16_diagnosis.label: Read the workshop instructions for protected self-diagnosis
goldfish.r16_diagnosis.line.1: The hall published R0ST’s protection sequence without publishing his private data: write lock, independent power, read-only examination.
goldfish.r16_diagnosis.line.2: My logger remains closed. The method can still help someone else.
goldfish.r16_diagnosis.line.3: You do not have to share everything to pass something on.
goldfish.r16_diagnosis.line.4: That is a good sentence for a cover.
goldfish.r16_warranty.label: Look at the old warranty request again
goldfish.r16_warranty.line.1: There is still room on the long receipt. R0ST writes no new classification on it. He notes the broken lamp from the hall, a needed seal, and the question of who will come to the garden tomorrow.
goldfish.r16_warranty.line.3: I still want to sort it out. But I do not need it as permission to sit here.
goldfish.r16_warranty.line.4: Good. Then stay. The gravel application is getting longer.
goldfish.r16_warranty.line.5: THE END – and an open task list.
